quests._desc: Ancestor tells you, "The Burun worship creatures known as Gurogs. The Gurogs are powerful beasts, and seem to draw their power from artifacts called Darkstones. Find a Gurog Emissary near the Chocker and bring its Darkstone back to me for study."
quests._walk:
Go to the Choker located at 23.6N, 82.3E, and kill a Gurog Emissary and loot a Darkstone off his body. Then return the Darkstone to the Ancestor Head you originally receive the quest from. The Ancestor Head tells you: "Ha! You mortal weaklings are so easily fooled. My Burun masters will be glad to receive this gift! Take this curse as your payment, and drag your wretched ..."
"wait ... I can help you ..."
"Quickly... I cannot fight off the Burun's corruption long. The curse can be lifted, but only if you slay a Burun Immortal. Do this, and I will undo the damage I have been forced to do. Now go, before my masters find out..."
You are now cursed with 2 spells (Burun Deceit and Darkstone Skin), and tells you that to remove the curse and complete the quest, you must now return to the Choker area and kill a Burun Immortal. Once you kill the Immortal, return to the Ancestor Head once again:
 Well done. I can break the curse now. Take the restored Darkstone as well before the Burun find it!" 
You receive your reward and the curses are lifted.

quests._desc: Greetings. Do you know much about the Mucor? There are a pair of very rare types of Mucor that seem to spawn mushrooms around them. Fascinating, isn't it? I'm trying to research what, exactly, causes this phenomenon. If you bring me the gland from a Degenerate Mucor Sporesower, I can teach you to make potions from the mushrooms that grow near them.
quests._walk:
Head to the Mucor Mushroom Grotto at 29.6N, 82.8E NE of the Central Farali Outpost (a dungeon first discovered by Dweia of Leafcull during the January 2003 event, Cacophony). When you first enter the dungeon you'll find a few degenerate mucors. As you work your way further down you will find many degenerate mucor sporesowers surrounded by mushrooms. Kill the sporesowers until you obtain a gland as a trophy drop. 
 Once you get a gland, return to Adesar in Ankoro. After you give him the gland he will give you a new quest recipe that will give you vigor over time. You will need a mushroom found in the dungeon and an item with 70 acid to make each potion. So when you go back make sure to pick up a few mushrooms for future use. 
 Adesar will next ask you to find and return a devolved mucor gland. The devolved mucor sporesowers are further down in the Grotto. Kill the sporesowers until you get a gland as a trophy drop and return the gland to Adesar for a recipe to make a health potion over time. 
 Each recipe now calls for a Mucor Mushroom and 100 Tallow. The recipe currently appears to be bugged, as it only consumes 1 Tallow.
 These recipes become a permanent part of your character. So long as you have mushrooms you will be able to make health and vigor over time potions. The reset time on the recipes is 12 hours, and the potions last 3 minutes, 30 seconds.

quests._desc: There are foul things at work in this world. There is something in a dungeon not far from here where Shreth are being twisted for some unknown purpose. I will reward you handsomely if you go to the Shreth Spawning Pit at 31.3N, 59.4E and bring me back the head of the creature that is responsible for these dark acts.
quests._walk:
The first step is to head to the Shreth Spawning Pit which is located at 31.3N, 59.4E (NE of Rakani). 
 The dungeon is fairly linear and doesn't offer any real twists or turns, but it is split into two parts. The first part is a "cave" and is loaded up with Hunter Shreths. You must kill them as you follow the tunnel, which is very linear. Eventually you will come to a large cavern that has 3 Hunter Shreths and 2 Ruruk Burun which you must dispatch. A picture of this cavern is provided below. 
 After you fight in the large cavern, you progress through and into the second part of this dugneon, which is no longer a cave, but a real "brick" walled dungeon. As soon as you progress in here, you will run into the Burun Doorkeeper and he must be killed so you can get Shrethwarden Key off his body, and open the Shrethwarden Door in the same room. 
 After you pass the door, keep following the dungeon straight through. Eventually you will come to a room that has a hallway leading to the left and right as well as continuing on straight. Keep going straight and ignore the left and right branches unless you feel like exploring. You will have to fight more Ruruk Burun's in this area, and you will also encounter your first Dark Hunter Shreth. Kill them all, and proceed through until you get to the last room, which has the Shrethwarden. There are also 2 Dark Hunter Shreths in the same room as the Shrethwarden, making this a little harder than normal. Kill the Shrethwarden, and take the Head Of the Burun Shrethwarden off him. 
 Note: When you kill the boss, 3 dark hunter shreths (6200+ hps) immediately spawn upon his death making it hard to loot the head. 
 Take the head back to Kiral in Rakani to complete the quest.

quests._desc: This is the 2nd of 3 quests to get the entire Tyrant Plate Armor suit.
quests._walk:
Tyke Geddon, Apprentice Armorsmith tells you, "Oh my goodness, it's terrible, just terrible. Recently, in my fater's absence, a hoard of tyrants destroyed our beloved armorsmithing shop, forcing my two elder brothers and me to flee for our lives. In the mass of confusion that ensued, we all became seperated. I ahve heard rumors that my brothers survived and have fled to nearby cities. However, we have yet to hear from our father, who was out collecting ingredients at the time. Please, I beg of you, seek him out and deliver this note letting him know of my safety. If possible return with a token from him so that I may know he is still alive. Thank you, brave adventurer, and make haste."
 He gives you a Tattered Note. Take Tattered Note to Tykes Dad (located west of the East Vesayan outpost) at 10.2N, 89.1E. Give him the note and he tells you this:
 Darvain Geddon, Master Armorsmith tells you, "I am glad to see Tyke is doing well. Unfortunately time is of the essence and I must continue on my quest. Take these forging gloves as proof we have spoken. Fare well." 
 Darvain gives you the Forging Gloves, which you are supposed to take back to Tyke Geddon in Keidelur. Take the gloves to Tyke, give them to him and he tells you this:
 Tyke Geddon, Apprentice Armorsmith tells you, "Amazing! You have found him! Bless the heavens he is still alive. As recompense for aiding me in this matter I will enlighten you to the project my father, my brothers and I were so diligently working on at the time of our shop's demise. We have developed a new type of armor, unmatched by any other in both strength and durability. If you prove your worth to me, I might let you in on exactly how one might go about making such an impeccable creation. Bring me back the tooth from a tyrant and we will discuss this matter further." 
 Get a Fang and give it to him and he says:
 Egads! You were able to collect the tooth! You are indeed a mighty hero. Please take this reipe. Due to the decimation of our shop we were never able to complete the collection needed to forge such an item. Perhaps someone as stoic as yourself can succeed where we failed. Good luck!" 
 He then gives you a recipe for Tyrant Plate Goves in which you can craft the gloves with.
 Components: 
 Unblemished Tyrant Scale 
 250 Silver 
 250 Sinew 
 Tyrant's Eye 
 Tyrant's Claw 
 Tyrant's Tooth 
 10,000 Gold

quests._desc: This is the 1rst of 3 quests to complete the Tyrant's Armor Quest
quests._walk:
Kiraly Geddon, Apprentice Armorsmith tells you, "A terrible thing it is that has happened! Pa was out collecting ingedients when out of nowhere a hoard of tyrants demolished our shop. it was as if they could smell the scales. Afraind for our lives we all fled as fast as we could and in the confusion became seperated. I have heard from travelers tha my brothers arrived in nearby cities unharmed; however, my father is still as of yet unaccounted for. Please brave soul, seek him out in the Vesayan Isles region and deliver this note to him telling him of the incident." 
 You are given a Crumpled Note, take the Crumpled Note to his dad, Darvain Geddon at 10.2N, 89.1E. 
 Darvain Geddon, Master Armorsmith tells you, "So Kiraly is safe. Good to hear. Take my shaping hammer as evidence of our meeting. I will not need it for the time being" 
 You are given a Shaping Hammer to take back to his son. When you take the Hammer back to Kiraly, he will tell you: 
 Kiraly Geddon, Apprentice Armorsmith tells you, "I am glad to see he is still alive. Now we can hoepfully all get back together and finish working on our latest invention: Tyrant Plate Armor - the strongest in all the land. I'd be willing to show you how to make it - but only if you're worthy enough a warrior. Return to me with the eye from a tyrant. Make haste." 
 When you give the Eye to Kiraly, he tells you:
 Kiraly Geddon, Apprentice Armorsmith tells you, "Incredible! your strength is indeed great. I will show you what we have learned thus far. Take this recipe. Perhaps you will have more success than we did collecting the ingredients." 
 You now have the recipe, simply gather the ingredients to create the Tyrant Plate Greaves.
 Components: 
 Pristine Tyrant Scale 
 Stone 85 
 Gemstone 50 
 Tyrant's Eye 
 Tyrant's Claw 
 Tyrant's Tooth 
 25,000 Gold

quests._walk:
Karu Geddon, Apprentice Armorsmith tells you, "I cannot believe it. Hear my story adventurer.  I knew Karu would be safe. Take this golden thread as a token of my appreciation. I must continue on my search. Go well, adventurer."

 When you give the Tyrant Claw to Karu, he tells you this: 
 Karu Geddon, Apprentice Armorsmith tells you, "Incredible! your strength is indeed great. Take this recipe I have promised you and guard its secrets well. Perhaps you shall succeed where we have failed." 
 You are given a recipe for Tyrant Plate Hauberk, gather the ingredients and craft the armor.

 Stone 90

quests._desc: This is the hardest of the 3 versions of the Soulbound quests to complete.
quests._walk:
Malga Dresovan tells you, "When I heard nightmare riders' triumphant screams piercing through the mist of my dreams, I knew. The unmistakable banshee wail from an age long ago and the hammering thud of ghostl hooves all herald the return of an evil rebuffed on this very soil. I have waited long, knowing that one day I would behold the face of one whose ancestors fled into the Shelters as I and my bretheren stood last guard. I ahve returned to arm you against evil to come. Nalicana's generosity and forethought in secreting the Fire Opal Crystal in the Imperator's Trove within the depths of Ossuary has served us well. Give this Crystal to the Linvak Weapons Golem who still stands in the old Linvak Armory, and it will set you on your path to create a Soulbound Weapon of Linvak Massif." 
 Travel to the Ossuary where you need to use a WRIT KEY to open the Chest and get a Fire Opal. After you get the Fire Opal from the Ossuary, you need to take it to the Linvak Massif Armory located at 13.4S, 11.0W (Oriad Ringway again) and give it to the Linvak Fetterguard Weapons Golem.
 After you turn in the Opal to the Golem, he tells you: 
 Linvak Fetterguard Weapons Golem tells you, "In the years since the Fetterguard's immolation the Gurog claimed this Armory as their own, smashing the Embers Golems with whom I had passed these lonely centuries. Take heart, for not all hope of obtaining the Embers recipes is lost. Knowing that we might not survive the years, a far-seeing member of the Fetterguard scattered Emblem Scrolls in the many treasure chests that exist on Linvak Massif. Malga, as a warrior of the Fetterguard, should be able to translate them for you. Choose your scroll wisely, for she may only have the strength to teach you one recipe." 
 Your Quest Tab now tells you to go the various singularity chests and use your singularity keys until you pull a scroll for the weapon of your choice. 
 For the Soulbound weapon, the next step after you turn in the scrolls is that you have to find 6 ebon pyreals for the crafting recipe for the Linvak Soulbound weapon. 
 Once you have created the emblem of the weapon you want, hand it in to the Weapons Golem at the end of the Armory. He will hand you back your weapon and complete your quest.
 Note: If you have completed the previous soulbound quests on Omishan, and Oseth, you can speak with the Fetterguard NPC at the top of the stairs in the room with the weapons golem to be admitted to the Fetterguard Shard for a 5 million XP reward, and a nice vignette.

quests._desc: This is the quest for the medium version of the Soulbound weapons.
quests._walk:
You need an Isin Dule key to open the chest at the bottom of the Dank Empyrean Ruins. In return you to get the Turqoise Emblem.
 Head back to the Omishan Armory (south of Shi) and go in. The Omishan Armory is actually a well designed and very straight forward dungeon. Broodu, Browerk, Reeshan, and other assorted burun are within. The Emblem golem is guarded by a few browerk, mymerdian, and burun immortals. 
 Give the Emblem to the golem at the enterance who turned it into a Rose Emblem. Now work your way through the Burun til you get the room with the grate in the floor and two waterfalls doing into it above a statue of Asheron and drop down under the waterfall on the Left side. Work your way to the room with the Immortal in it, behind him is the room with the specialized golems. You turn in your rose activation crystal to the emblem golem of your desired weapon class, and then you take the portal to the surface and go back in, craft the emblem, then turn it in to the weapons golem at the top of the dungeon. 
 Give them the Rose Emblem:
 Melee Emblems Golem tells you, "I shall now give you the recipe to create an Omishan melee-weapon Emblem. You will need to find White Pyreal to compelte it. The recent thaws have uncovered deposits of this type of pyreal in the Veseyan Isles and Farali Wastes. Be on your guard -- the Burun will also be on the hunt for this precious metal. No doubt they will have stores of pyreal upon them as well." 
 Head to the beach outside of Sanc and start killing Buruns for your White Pyreal, you need 6 to make your weapon. White Pyreal has also been known to drop off from Awaro-bal and Khero-bal. 
After you get the 6 pieces of white pyreal you craft another seal. Then you need to return to the Weapons golem in the Omishan Armory and give that to him to receive your weapon reward.

quests._desc: This quest if for the lowest version of the soulbound weapons.
quests._walk:
Tamar tells you, "In death's sleep I heard the drumming of the ghostly riders' hooves. I knew it was time once again to rise against the evil that destroyed my bretheren. You must be a child of my people, who filed into the Shelters as we Fetterguard held the Nemesis tides at bay. My duty is done, but you must now defend our land from the darkness lying ahead. The Weapons Golem has freed itself from centuries of dirt and rubble in the very center of the Prosper Fettermound. It is ready for service, but must be activated first. Nalicana's preparations weren't for naught - the moonstone Activation Crystals that she secreted in Asheron's Cache in the Firey Crypt will make the Golem once more. Take the Crystal to the Golem, and the creature will arm you for the dark days ahead." 
 She tells you to go get the Moonstone Activation Crystal from Asherons Cache in the Fiery Crypt (5.6n, 16.7e). You will need an Asherons Sigil to open the cache, you can get one by doing the Illuminated Script quest. You can also use the Asheron's Cache in the Warder's Hideout instead of the one in Fiery Crypt. It is MUCH easier to get to.
 Take the Crystal to the Osteth Weapon Golem. (5.9N 8.4E, found near the South Outpost on the Prosper Ringway) Give the Crystal to the Golem and he will ask you to fetch a Soulbound Emblem so he can create you a weapon. 
 Osteth Weapons Golem tells you, "Centuries ago, the Fetterguard of Osteth employed me to manufacture the Soulbound weapons they carried in their last standa gainst the Drudges. If my services are again required, it can only mean that the descendants of the Shelters have emerged to reclaim their lands. Seek the Drudges of this region - in their plundering of the land, they have unearthed the soulbound Embers that were once my brother Golem's to give. Fond of the shiny and bright, the drudges know not what they carry. Relieve them of their trophies and bring me a soulbound Emblem of Osteth emblazoned with the weapon of your choice. Once I receive it, I shall manufacture a soulbound Weapon for you. 
 The Quest Journal tells you the Drudges carrying the Emblems can be found in the Osteth Marshes and Drudge Citadel regions. I personally went to Drudge Citadel and found the group just at the giant bones drop the most. 
 You need an Emblem of the weapon you desire in order to get it.

quests._desc: This is the high level Artefon Armor quest.
quests._walk:
When you speak with Simlan, he tells you:
 "Quickly, friend. When i HEARD THE WATERS OF THE LAKE WERE DRAINING, I crept down here to the emerging ruins of Aretfon in hopes of discovering the entrance to the fabeled necropolis housing the tombs of the kings of old. However, our ancient enemies have proven too quick. While our backs were turned, they seized the ancient ruins and the treasures laying beneath them. I'm safely barricaded here, but I still must know whether the tombs of our Kings lie sacrosanct... find them and report their condition to me, and I will reward you with the recipe to create the Armor of the Ancient Kings." 
 Enter the Catacombs of Artefon located at 13.8N, 9.4E, SE of Rithwic, across the lake on a small island.
 Find the following tombs and touch them to advance the quest:
 Tomb of Aulatha
 Tomb of Borelean
 Tomb of Elysa
 Tomb of Kei
 Tomb of Kresovus
 Tomb of Thorsten
 The catacombs are like a maze. Bring a group, as the tombs are all surrounded by undead that DRAIN your vigor and are level 55. It's a nasty dungeon.
 Once you're finished, return to Simlan. He will tell you:
 "Search for the correct materials and craft a set of the Armor of the Ancient Kings for yourself. Sontar Trisoya has discoverd the lost Emerald Mines of Ulkas in the mountatins between the Nepth Strata and the Stoeneshadow Plain. The Gurog of Linvak Massif still hoard their stores of Ebon Pyreal. Orlen Jarlns has found Shoyanen's lost method of imbuing emeralds near her old tower." 
 First, seek out Orlen Jarlns in Mayoi at 5.7S, 49.2E. He will give you Shoyanen's Solutions quest, which you must complete to get the recipes needed to imbue the Emeralds.
 The steps for Shoyanen's Solutions are as follows (see Shoyanen's Solutions for more detailed information):
 Speak to Orlen and give him a Shadow Totem. He will give you Alembic.
 Locate some Aconite flowers. They can be found on the second hop of the Mayoi portal ring. Each flower can make between 1 and 14 infusions, so get at least a couple.
 Give the Alembic to the Mist Curl Geyser at 23.8S, 1.2E in the Oriad region to get Waters of Mist Curl Vale.
 Use your quest recipe to combine the Waters of Mist Curl Vale with an Aconite flower, which will create a Suspension of Aconite.
 Note: Creating 1 potion will take the recipe out of your quest panel. Just hand the alembic back to the geyser to regain the recipe and continue creating potions. ALSO : Create 1 extra potion (14 in total) because Orlen will keep 1 for himself, the others will be used to imbue your Emeralds.
 Give the Suspension to Orlen. He will then give you the recipe needed to imbue the Emeralds. Each Emerald will need to be imbued with one Suspension of Aconite.
 Once you've completed that portion of the quest, you will need the Emeralds, which are found south of Ondekodo at the Emerald Mines at 24.2S, 31.8W (drop down the ravine to get to the entrance).
 To enter the mine, you will need to give Sontar Risoya an Ebon Pyreal. He also tells you to use the portals but that once you mine 13 emeralds, he is going to ask you for another Ebon Pyreal to re-enter the portal.
 When you enter the mines, it brings you to the Base of the Ulkas Mountain Range. Then you need to port up the mountain to the mines. Note, you need an Ebon Pyreal for access to the mines. Only one person in your group needs the Ebon to gain your entire group's entrance. DO NOT DIE HERE... there is a bug that if you die after you have mined a few gems, it will not let you come back up the mountain, and it screws up your quest. This has been reported as a BUG.
 This area is very nasty... you need a good group. The method we used was to kill the group of mobs by the closest mine, then mine for the gems like crazy, stopping only to kill respawn. Once you have mined 13 gems, your quest advances and says you have completed it.
 All that is left then is to finish collecting the ingrediants you need to make the armor. So to recap, to make the armor you need:
 The Imbued Emeralds which you craft from the recipe that you got from Orlon. You will need to return with your Glass Alembic to keep re-dipping it for the recipe. There are reports that the flower Aconite lasts several times before you need to get another one. Have not confirmed this yet.
 Finally, you need EBON PYREALS in your armor recipes. Below are the recipes:
 Helm of the Ancient Kings 
 3 Imbued Emeralds
 3 Ebon Pyreals
 Greaves of the Ancient Kings 
 3 Imbued Emeralds
 4 Ebon Pyreals
 Gloves of the Ancient Kings 
 2 Imbued Emeralds 
 3 Ebon Pyreals
 Breastplate of the Ancient Kings 
 3 Imbued Emeralds
 5 Ebon Pyreals
 Boots of the Ancient Kings 
 2 Imbued Emeralds
 3 Ebon Pyreals
 TOTALS 
 13 Imbued Emeralds
 18 Ebon Pyreals
 Thanks to Aether, Hadorak, and Illyana for the fellow that helped me put this together, and others whose names have escaped me.
 Reported Bugs 
 There have been reports that your recipe for the imbued emerald disappears after your quest advances after retrieving 13 gems. Please report this to ACCMTY if this happens to you. This happened to a member of my group.
 Do not die at the Emerald Mines after you have begun mining and gathered some gens. Doing so halts your quest and you cannot advance it.

quests.title: Armor of the Ancient Kings

quests._desc: This is the Level 20+ Ancient Armor quest.
quests._walk:
Speak with Tima and you will receive this message:
 "Greetings, friend. I have been researching the history of the ruins that were exposed by the lakes receding waters. I have come to believe they were once the magnificent city of Artefon, whose vast necropolis housed the final remains of the greatest of the golden age. I have a particular interest in knowing the location and condition of the Tombs of the Knights from that era. Discover them for me and I will reward you with the knowledge to create a set of armor of great knowledge." 
 Now you will have to search out the tombs of the knights on the West Shore of Lake Artefon:
 Tomb of the Prophet of Blades , 19.6N, 6.4E
 Tomb of the Zharalim , 20.5N, 6.9E
 Tomb of a Knight of the Unicorn , 20.5N, 5.3E
 Tomb of the Knight Flame , 17.8N, 6.4E
 Tomb of the Knight Dragon , 16.6N, 4.7E
 Tomb of the Knight Shield , 19.3N, 4.9E
 After double clicking on each of the tombs, the quest info should update each time. Return to Tima Drokh. She will give you this message:
 "It is as I feared--the tombs have been desecrated and thier contents have been removed, Who could have done such a thing, and why? The Warders of Osteth must be notified. Thank you for your diligence. In my research of the city I uncovered the ancient means to create the armor of the Ancients Knights, which I will now grant to you. I've Heard that Ilia Grayten recently announced her discovery of the lost Ruby Mines once owned by the great Master Smith Ulkas. Word of her discovery came from the west, at the base of the Cobalt Mountians. She might be able to help you find the jewels you need to complete your armor. Another acquaintance, Orlen Jarlns, has found Shoyanen's lost method of imbuing rubies. He is now living near her old tower." 
 You should now have the recipies for the armor in you Quest reciepe crafting menu.
 Now you will need to obtain 8 rubies. You can do this one of two ways. You can locate and kill the Undead Knights that hang around near the tomb area, who drop 1 ruby each, or you can go to the Ruby Mines.
 To get to the Ruby Mines you will need one Ferrous Pyreal to give to Ilia Grayten at 16.6N, 4.6W near Molwirth. Give her the pyreal and enter the mines. There are 3 mines that you can mine from. Remember you need 8 Rubies which is all you will be allowed to mine anyway.
 Next go find Orlen Jarlns who will give you the Shoyanen's Solution quest so that you can imbue the Rubies. He is located at 5.7S 49.2E east of the town of Mayoi. Speak with him to receive the Shoyanen's Solutions quest.
 The steps for Shoyanen's Solutions are as follows (see Shoyanen's Solutions for more detailed information):
 Speak to Orlen and give him a Shadow Totem. He will give you Alembic.
 Locate some Aconite flowers. They can be found on the second hop of the Mayoi portal ring. Each flower can make between 1 and 14 infusions, so get at least a couple.
 Give the Alembic to the Atolu Geyser at 22.6N, 48.4E in the Ariaki region to get Waters of Atolu.
 Use your quest recipe to combine the Waters of Atolu with an Aconite flower, which will create a Decoction of Aconite.
 Give the Decoction to Orlen. He will then give you the recipe needed to imbue the Rubies. Each Ruby will need to be imbued with one Decoction of Aconite.
 Once you complete Shoyanen's Solutions, you must locate 12 more Ferrous Pyreals. They drop off Inferno Gloom Drudges, Drudge Conscripts and various other locations such as the Prosper region they spawn directly on the ground.
 Use the armor recipes to create your armor. You will need a total of 12 Ferrous Pyreals and 8 Imbued Rubies.

quests.title: Armor of the Ancient Knights

quests._desc: This quest allows you to imbue your Rubies, Sapphires, or Emeralds for the Ancient Armor quests.
quests._walk:
When you speak with Orlen Jarlns, he will give you this message:
 "Greetings stranger. My former research led me here to the famed tower of Shoyanen Kenchu. Through my excavation near this tower I discovered her lost recipes for the infusions which allowed Master Smith Ulkas to imbue the gems of his Armor of the Ancients with magic beyond compare. As my scholarly focus includes many subjects, I also believe the objects within the Hoard of Chaos deserve further research. I am now willing to make an exchange - bring me a Shadow Totem, and I will give you my Alembic, instruct you in its use, and show you how to imbue the jewles from the Ulkas mines with power." 
 Now you have to find a Shadow Totem and bring it to him. He will then say:
 "Thank you! There has been a small amount of geothermal activity in the lesser isles of western Ariaki, eastern Lumari, and the Mist Curl Vale of Oriad. Fill up this Alembic with Mineral Water from one of the Geysers that have sprung up in each of these areas. Combine the Aconite flowers that grow here in the Kydi Delta and the Ariaki River Delta with this Mineral Water into an infusion and give it to me for inspection. I will then show you how to imbue jewels from the Ulkas mines with magic. Keep in mind that the water flowing from each of these regions is subtly different, and when combined with Aconite will yeild a different type of infusion." 
 He will give you a glass Alembic. Fill it with water from one of the following geysers:
 Atolu Geyser 22.6N, 48.4E (Armor of the Ancient Knights, Rubies)
 Coralen Geyser 27.5N, 89.4E (Armor of the Ancient Lords, Sapphires)
 Mist Curl Geyser 23.8S, 1.2E (Armor of the Ancient Kings, Emeralds)
 Then combine the water with an aconite plant to create the solution to imbue your Rubies, Emeralds, or Sapphires using the following recipes:
 Decoction of Aconite (Imbue Rubies) 
 1 Aconite 
 1 Waters of Atolu 
 Infusion of Aconite (Imbue Sapphies) 
 1 Aconite 
 1 Waters of Coralen 
 Suspension of Aconite (Imbue Emeralds) 
 1 Aconite 
 1 Waters of Mist Curl Vale 
 Make one potion and return it to him. Each Aconite flower will make between 1 and 14 potions randomly. After you give him one of the potions you will receive this message (if you used Rubies, the others are similar):
 "Good job! I shall reserve this infusion for my future research, but take this recipe. I hear the fabled ruby mines of Ulkas have been discovered by a woman named Ilia Grayten in the Cobalt Mountains. This recipe will help you imbue the rubies from these mines with magical properties that have been lost to the world until now. Good luck in your travels, adventurer." 
 Now you have the recipes to imbue your Rubies, Sapphires, or Emeralds for the Artefon Armor quests. Use the Decoction of Aconite, Infusion of Aconite, or Suspension of Aconite with a Ruby, Sapphire, or Emerald respectively to imbue your gems.

quests._desc: This is the level 30+ Ancient Armor quest.
quests._walk:
When you speak with Minauri, she will tell you:
 "Greetings, adventurer. Evil has come to the heart of Osteth and now festers in the fabled ruins of Artefon. The remains of the greatest lords of the Golden Age where put to rest past the eastern banks of the River Artefon. After this season's events I fear for their sanctity. Please journey east across the river, find the tombs, and report back to me. In return, I will pass on my knowledge of the arts required to create the Armor of the Ancient Lords, whose remains I send you now to investigate. Go now, I shall remain here and hope for happy news upon your return." 
 First, you'll need to find and use each of the following tombs along the East area of the Lake Artefon Basin:
 Tomb of Lord Ulkas 14.9N, 10.7E
 Tomb of Lord Shoyanen 17.7N, 10.1E
 Tomb of Lord Aleval 22.2N, 10.0E
 Tomb of Lord Tikauri 15.9N, 10.4E
 Tomb of Lord Aurutis 21.8N, 8.1E
 Tomb of Lord Ralirea 19.4N, 9.7E
 Next head back to speak to Minauri again, who will tell you:
 "Tima was correct to bring me here. He has reported similar disturbances on the western shores of the river as well. The systemic desecration of Artefon's graves does not bode well for our future, my friend. I have much to think about now, but before you leave, I will reward you as promised. A miner by the name of Ihipona recently claimed that she discovered the long lost Sapphire Mines of Ulkas, the great master smith. Word of her discovery from the Shim Mountain Range near the Ariaki region - if you find her there, she may be able to help you find the Sapphires to complete your armor. Another acquaintance, Orlen Jarlns, has found Shoyanen's lost method of imbuing sapphires. He is living near her old tower now." 
 She will also give you the recipes for the armor. You can mine the Sapphies at the Sapphire Mines located at 6.1N 46.5E, near the Northern Kydi Outpost or from the corpses of the knights that wander near the tombs. To get in the mines, you must give Ihipona a White Pyreal.
 Before you can mine any sapphires, you must kill the big skeleton guard boss inside the mines.
 After getting all the sapphires, find and speak to Orlen Jarlens at 5.7S, 49.2E. He
is East of Mayoi on the penninsula. He will give you Shoyanen's Solutions quest, which you must complete in order to get the recipes needed to imbue the Sapphires.
 The steps for Shoyanen's Solutions are as follows (see Shoyanen's Solutions for more detailed information):
 Speak to Orlen and give him a Shadow Totem. He will give you Alembic.
 Locate some Aconite flowers. They can be found on the second hop of the Mayoi portal ring. Each flower can make between 1 and 14 infusions, so get at least a couple.
 Give the Alembic to the Coralen Geyser at 27.5N, 89.4E in the Farali region to get Waters of Coralen.
 Use your quest recipe to combine the Waters of Coralen with an Aconite flower, which will create an Infusion of Aconite.
 Give the Infusion to Orlen. He will then give you the recipe needed to imbue the Sapphires. Each Sapphire will need to be imbued with one Infusion of Aconite.
 Finally, use your crafting recipes to create the armor. Here are the requirements for crafting each piece of the armor:
 Boots of the Ancient Lords 
 2 White Pyreals
 2 Imbued Sapphires
 Breastplate of the Ancient Lords 
 5 White Pyreals
 3 Imbued Sapphires
 Gloves of the Ancient Lords 
 2 White Pyreals
 2 Imbued Sapphires
 Greaves of the Ancient Lords 
 4 White Pyreals
 3 Imbues Sapphires
 Helm of the Ancient Lords 
 3 White Pyreals
 2 Imbued Sapphires
 TOTALS 
 16 White Pyreals
 12 Imbued Sapphires

quests._desc: This is a short quest that involves only speaking to NPCs.
quests._walk:
When you speak with Akkilea, he will say the following:
 "The humans say that the enemy of my enemy is my friend. Perhaps so. Please seek out the Sachem Mimbu in Mayoi and see what he has to say about our common enemy, the sclavi. Needless, to say, you must not harm any mimbu while you are on this mission. You have two hours."
 Go to the Mimbu Village located at 0.2S, 40.8E and speak with the Mimbu Shaman . He will tell you:
 "K-k. No! We hate Sclavi, but no like you neither! Akkilea kill many Mimbu one time. All Tumerok kill Mimbu. We not fight with you. Go now, or Mimbu warriors will kill you bad!"
 If you talk to the Sachem again he asks if you have a gift, I thought he could be bribed I tried giving him: Aconite, Ebon, weapons, Grub Meat, potion, gold, sclavus venom, sclavus tail, a dipped talisman from grub meat quest. His response to them was he didn't need them. Maybe someone could figure out what he actually needed?
 Return to Akkilea and he tells you:
 "A pity the Sachem is so unwilling to cooperate. Perhaps his position is understandable considering the violence so many of our folk have inflected on his tribesman. Still, it was a job well done to seek him out, and it may be that in the future there will be an understanding between our peoples."
 You receive 15,000 XP for completing the quest.

quests.title: Mimbu Negotiations

quests._desc: This quest involves killing a Tyrant named Lady Silva to acquire the Tyrant Helm.
quests._walk:
When you speak to Darvain Geddon, he will tell you:
 Darvain Geddon, Master Armorsmith tells you, "After all my wanderings, I have succeeded in my mission! I have discovered the ingredients for the perfect enchantment for a Tyrant Helm, one that would make its wearer immune to the caprices of the Lord of Tyrants. To prove yourself worthy of my gift of the recipe to create this wondrous item, slay the Lady Silva, the Tyrant Lord's own brood-sister. She now cares for her brood in the very bowels of the fiery calderas of the Vesayan Isles."
 You must then head to Silva's Lair at 12.5N, 89.6E. Then descend into the Lair to fight and slay Lady Silva ( view image ). Then return to Darvain Geddon, and he will say:
 Darvain Geddon, Master Armorsmith tells you, "Congratulations! You have braved the Lady Silva's fiery wrath and lived to tell the tale. Here is the quest recipe for the Tyrant Helm with my blessings, for you have earned it." 
 You now have a recipe to craft the Tyrant Helm . The ingredients needed are as follows:
 1 Tyrant Tooth (from a Storm Tyrant)
 1 Tyrant Claw (from a Crag Tyrant)
 1 Tyrant Eye (from a Squall Tyrant)
 1 Tyrant Tongue (from a Spindrift Tyrant)
 1,000 Gold
 Here are the stats of the Tyrant Helm ( view image ):
 Armor Rating: 25
 Combat Delay: 15
 Worn On: Head
 Effect When Worn:
Tyrant's Ward: Grants you partial immunity to Quiescence, Blindness, and Quelling.
 You will also receive 1,000,000 XP upon completion of the quest.

quests.title: Slay Lady Silva

quests._walk:
Upon speaking with Akkilea, he will say the following:
 Akkilea tells you, "Greetings adventurer. I must ask you in all humility for a personal favor. I hope you will be so kind as to help me complete my ritual purification this day. My spirit is as yet... unclean... and I must seek forgiveness from a power greater than myself. Yet I must not leave my post at this time. Please take this talisman for me, and see that it is blessed by one who has the power to forgive my sins against the land." 
 You will also receive Akkilea's Talisman :
 You must then head to the Mistress of Shadows in Ikeras (Shadow Kingdom NPC) at 10.8N, 62.2E. She tells you:
 The Mistress of Shadows tells you, "Set forth on the Way of Power and I will speak with thee further."
 The Mistress of Shadows tells you, "Oh? And why should I waste my power on a failure? Akkilea is a fool if he thinks he can obtain forgiveness from the Shadow."
 You must then head to the Servant of the Empire in Ikeras (Dominion Kingdom NPC) at 9.5N, 63.1E. She tells you:
 The Servant of the Empire tells you, "Sadly, the one you call Akkilea has not submitted his will to the Dominion. He should not expect us to spend our power on his behalf."
 You must then head to the Hand of Asheron in Ikeras (Order Kingdom NPC) at 10.1N, 62.1E. He tells you:
 The Hand of Asheron tells you, "What? The traitor Akkilea calls on us for absolution? He has not yet redeemed his foul deeds. I am truly sorry, but Asheron's blessing cannot be bestowed on his behalf."
 He also rejects it leaving the quest stuck. I was intrigued by this and thought about it for a moment, Akkilea wanted to be purified by a greater power of the land. Se besides the three kingdom NPCs who else is a great power of the land? I took the amulet to the Deru Tree at 28.1N, 55.1E in Rakani and this is what happened:
 You gave the Akkilea's Talisman to the Great Deru Shrine.
 You place the talisman on the altar. For a moment nothing happens, and then a faint fleeting gleam can be seen from the talisman, which quickly vanishes. You sense emotions emanating from the great tree: amusement is followed by anger, which gives way to sorrow. The impressions of emotion slowly fade, and are replaced by a feeling of calmness and wellbeing. Your journal for the Purification quest has been updated.
 You received the Akkilea's Talisman from the Great Deru Shrine.
 Return to Akkilea and he says:
 Akkilea tells you, "Ah, youngling, you return. I suppose the quest was fruitless... as usual. Well you have my thanks anyway for your time spent on my behalf. What? Wait! The talisman! It lives! A portion of my burden has been lifted! Ah, you wonder was this was about. Some time ago I unknowingly fell prey to the delusion that peace could be negotiated with the Burun. In my enthusiasm, I led our people into a terrible massacre. I alone survived, I think because the loathsome creatures wished to torment me. Since then I have sought forgiveness, and always been rejected... until today. You have given me hope, my friend, and you have my deepest gratitude."
 You receive 25,000 XP for completing the quest.

 He will then return the weapon imbued with the following:
 Slayer: Increases damage done to Burun
 You receive 10,000 XP for completing the quest.

quests._desc: A short delivery style quest involving speaking to various NPCs.
quests._walk:
When you speak with Akkilea, he will say the following:
 "Greetings, youngling. The struggle against the Burun is not going well. They are receiving assistance from their masters, the Gurog monsters of the Linvak Massif. I wish you to journey to Linvak to find the Factotum of Whitebay, and then return to me with any advice he may have."
 Head to Whitebay and speak with Pelloran, Whitebay Factotum located in Whitebay at 21.6S, 4.7W. He says to you: 
 "Ah. Akkilea, I know of him. Trouble with the Burun, eh? A pity we do not have the resources to come to the direct aid of our bretheren in Omishan. But a joint Strategy makes sense against the Nemesis forces. Please go back to Oseth to talk to Kanten (Cavendo Factotum), then return to Akkilea, and together we shall arrange a meeting to plan our next moves."
 Now go to Cavendo and speak with Kanten, Cavendo Factotum located at 16.2N, 28.4E. He says to you:
 "What? Akkilea and Peloran want to meet? Well....I suppose I can fit them into my busy schedule."
 Go back to Akkilea in Zu, and he says to you:
 "Hmm. I suppose a joint strategy makes a good deal of sense. Thank you for arranging the meeting."

quests._walk:
After killing a bloodstone it may give the quest and open up a destablized portal to the Archons holding.
"Shards from the bloodstone have embedded in your skin. The twised magics have weaved their way throughout your form, temporarily making you appear as an Undead creature. Explore the area where the portal has led you. The Undead found in the halls seem to be mistaking you as one of their own. There may be a way within these twisting passages to keep your disguise." 
You appear undead and a portal appears. After going through the portal you are in the Archons Holding, nothing will attack you as long as youre under the undead effect. To maintain the effect you must touch Bloodstones in a specific order and you wil need to pick up keys along the way.
If you attack anything the effect wears off, and if you die the quest fails. To complete touch the bloodstones in order then exit through the portal to Fortress Guroka.
Bloodstone Order:
 Partial Bloodstone in Holding
 Broken Bloodstone in Hahnain's Seminary and get a Battered Key
 Fragmented Bloodstone in Renselm's Laboratory and get a Battered Key
 Drained Bloodstone in Holding and get a Battered Key
 Leaking Bloodstone in Holding Cells and get 2 Battered Keys (there are 3 locked cells with bloodstones, only open the one with the leaking bloodstone, since there are 2 keys in holding cells, you will have a spare).
 Incomplete Bloodstone in Saelar's Library
Map of the holding

quotes.text:
The High Priestess does not move or speak, but oddly enough your attention is directed to the nearby Orb. You are suddenly aware that you have
been directed to perform some strange task. Perhaps the orb will explain matters further.

You stare into the heart of the mystical Orb.
Suddenly, a vision transports you to another time and place. You see three robed figures, a Human, a Virindi, and a Shadow, standing before a
gigantic prismatic gem apparently conducting some esoteric ritual. Battle rages around them, as mortal defenders of several races strive to defend
the three from what seems to be an endless onslaught of Shadow warriors. Together, the three figures strike at the gem with magic bolts, and it
shatters into a million lost fragments. Three larger fragments of the gem float briefly above their heads, and flare with starlike energies before
vanishing. A vortex of energy rises from the shattered gem, and swirls through the scattering shards, causing them to twinkle and vanish. A
scream of rage rises from the attacking Shadow army, perhaps indicating their mission had failed.
The vision slowly fades, and you are filled with a sense of the High Priestess' sorrow and loss.

quests._walk:
There is a new crack in the wall in Hoshinos room that leads to the Deeper Catacombs, there you find her beloved Borelean Strathelar. Slay him, and loot the Silver Key from him. 
From there head into the Neether Catacombs, locate and kill Sanguine Bloodstone, and retrieve a Bloodstone Fragment . 
Take the key and fragment to the Outer Catacombs, in a room there is a new crack in the wall that leads to the Forgotten Catacombs. Find the door to the Sacred Font, put the Bloodstone Fragment in the font 
and it becomes a Lifestone Fragment . 
Return this fragment to Hoshino in the Lower Catacombs for your reward and ending the quest.

quests._walk:
Upon speaking with her, she gives you a quest to repair the forge if you have an armorcrafting skill of 200+. 
Then look into the Obr of Insight.
 "As you gaze into the Orb, you see a vision of times past.
The Master Smith and her assistants are hard at work on the forge. From strange and esoteric elements, they are producing many unusual
pieces of armor.
Periodically a warrior will visit the forge to be outfitted in one of three types of armor suits. Under the eyes of a mage, strange glowing crystals are
mounted in the armor pieces, and the suits are transformed into wonderous artifacts." 
 You must craft a new hearthstone. 
 Ingredients for Hearthstone:
 Iron 80+
 Stone 80+
 Acid 80+
 Crystal 80+
 Obsidian 80+ 
Give the Hearthstone to the Mastersmith.
 "The Master Smith bows deeply to you and to the hearth. Suddenly, your mind is filled with many secrets of ancient lore. She gestures at the nearby orb, and smiles at you, then turns away." 
You have unlocked 15 recipes to craft unfinished ancient armor (5 for each race). Note: The recipes are not quest recipes they are among the normal armorsmithing recipes for each race. 
 Unfinished Ancient Armor
(Used for making Kingdom Armor, see Radiant Elightenment quest )

quests._walk:
Next, go (with a full fellowship of your kingdom) to 56.6n 4.0w. Kill the Prismatic Guardian there. 
Next, head to a temple (listed below). 
Killing the guardian brings the temples back to life. If there is a Prismatic Radiant on a pedestal, check to see if it is your kingdom. If it is not, 
or it is not there, kill the guardian next to the temple. If the Prismatic Radiant is not there and there is no guardian, go back to start. 
After the 
Radiant is aligned to you, monsters of the opposing kingdoms will spawn (order=golems, shadow=shadows, dominion=virindi). Kill these. 
When it is safe, run up 
and touch the Radiant. You will get a ray of your kingdom and a quest that allows you to loot lenses off of corpses (Radiant Empowerment 30 minute timer). Loot at least one lens from each opposing kingdom. 
Hand these lenses to the Radiant. You will receive a matching ray of that kingdom back. You can loot as many lenses from opposing kingdom mobs and turn them in as much as you like during the 30 minutes. Visit the other four temples and gather a total of 45 Rays to turn into 3 Prismatic Stars. The break down is that you need 3 rays for each kingdom of each of the 5 temple colors.
In addition to this quest, you can create these bonus crystals to wear and eventually imbue your armor with.
Once you have gathered enough rays you can craft the Radiant stars needed to finish this quest. Creating 3 Radiant stars finishes the Quest
Return to the Radiant Temple and use the Orb beside the master crafter, you are then given the recipes under Quest recipes/Kingdom Armor to create your Kingdom armor. Once you create the armor you can then imbue your new Kingdom armor with Radiant Crystals.

quests._walk:
Enter dungeon. Go down hallway and jump down. Head straight down hallway 
into a blue portal.
 Go down next hallway. DO NOT step onto platform with chest or corroded key. 
Doing so will kill you.
Jump down head straight north and enter purple portal.
 In next hallway. go straight, jump down and then head straight up, while 
hugging left wall. there is a hidden wall on the left leading to a hidden 
red portal. 
 Go down hallway target the blue portal below you and jump down. Immediately press 
F to avoid being killed by dragoons.
 This will take u to a LONG hallway. Head straight down hallway towards 
barrel, killing revs in process. At T-junction, turn left and head straight 
killing revs. Pass junction and hug right wall. Hidden right wall will lead 
you to hidden junction and hidden green portal. 
 In this hallway, go straight up till you get into room with undead. You need 2 keys both from hidden rooms that are lead to by hidden 
walls. There is a key in the left corridor, and the other on the right. With those 2 keys. go straight north and unlock first door. Hug 
right side of the wall and walk thru the invisible platform to oppersite 
wall on the right to walk on an invisible platform. Use next key on the opposite door. Enter portal.
 Fight though and kill the Undead Lord Ordainer and the Penultimate Guardian , upon Killing the guardian you recieve the quest to get your prize. 
 "The death of the Penultimate Guardian has filled you with magical energy that enables you to use the portal to the Guardian's Hoard... if you can find it."
"Make sure your entire fellowship has entered the portal to the hoard room, or someone may not get their reward." 
DO NOT click on eternal splendor portal, as it will instantly kill you. Head back to corridor before enternal splendor portal room and hug right wall enter 
secret wall. Go straight to reward room through a portal. 
 Do not let anyone in your fellow open the chest until all fellow members have made it into the reward chamber as opening it will complete the quest for evryone in the fellow and they will be unable to get their reward.

 Shield of the Sun

 111-111 Damage
 Level 45

The person who has the sword must hit him with the sword, it will instantly kill the warath, but if someone tries to attack or debuff him he will one shot everyone.

Make your way slowly back out to Vargil and hand him the sword. The way out is blocked by Noble grubs, fetid Perchers, and a Weeping Bloodstone so be ready. 
If you use a portal, die or leave the world you wil fail the quest.

quests._desc: This is the quest to receive your Hero mount, a Gromni from AC1.
quests._walk:
Take the egg to the egg collector in Mayoi. 
She tells you the egg needs to be cleansed. Go to the Water Temple north of mayoi and work your way down to the treasure chest. Behind the chest are 3 obelisks. 
 Use the obelisks in the following order (as you face them):
 Center
 Left
 Center
 Left
 Right
 Left
 Right
 Center
 Left
 Left
 Right
 Center
 After each touch, you should hear a faint clicking noise. If you don't, start over at center obelisk. 
When you complete the pattern, you will be portaled to a fountain guarded by a Guardian of the Sacred Waters. 
Place the egg in the fountain to cleanse it.
Return to the egg collector and give her the egg, she says she doesnt know how you could hatch this but yoy should find a way.
To hatch it go to the Forlorn Nesting Tyrant at 17.5 N, 83.8 E (island south of slaughter plains on farali ringway). Give her the egg and wait five IN GAME hours. after 5 hours return to the Nesting tyrant and receive your egg. To summon a mount just use the egg, no time limit while mounted.
Quest reward: Crystaline Tyrant Egg , and 7,500,000Xp
Note: Each mount costs 25 focus to summon the mount, but if you have no focus you can still summon the mount. Also it does not expire.

quests._desc: You must return the mosswart to the saftey of his home.
quests._walk:
Once the spawn is clear, a designated person should start the quest by using the Fungal Mosswart Hut. The starter will receive a Mosswart "pet" that will not do anything but follow her or him. 
Everybody in the fellowship will then receive a quest to protect the Mosswart. The fellowship must now slowly journey east to 18.8N, 42.6W where you will find a fenced off area that contains a Mosswart Hut. Once you are by the hut, double click on the Mosswart to finish and receive your experience reward. 
Protect the mosswart at all costs, if he dies you all fail, but can start over immediately.
 Tips: 
 Keep the mosswart within 2-3 radar rings of the person who it is following anymore and it will wander back to the starting point, any less and he stops slowing you down.
 /pet return command works, use it.
 Watch for Olthoi Spawns along the way, they spawn very close to your mosswart.
 If somone dies it will fail for that member. 
 If you fail you can restart immediatly.
 Make sure only one person gets the mosswart, anymore and it becomes a hassle.

quests.title: Find a Good Spear

quests._desc: Lupe wants you to collect 3 moarsmen fins for her Uncle's soup.
quests._walk:
Run SE down the road in Hakata. Once out of town, kill everyything along the road, especially the Fetid Moarsmen - you want the fins that drop off of them. Stick to the beach area, continueing to make your way south, killing everything. If you are lucky you will get all 3 fins in one pass. 
If not, continue south along the beach, around the tip and start on the way north, staying on the beach. Once you get to the road that goes (west) back to the other side of the island, take it and then start south along the beach. Rinse and repeat until you have your 3 fins. 
 Go back to Lupe and give her the 3 fins .. one at at time.

quests._desc: Destroy a portal beacon and loot the Burun Supply chest to get a pet Burun. There are several ringways that the outposts are infested with Burun, in the area around the outposts there are named monsters that can start this quest.
quests._walk:

 Now head to the outpost mentioned in your quest panel and destroy the portal beacon. Once it is destroyed loot the shard, and use it as a key to finish your quest. 
 Important: Make sure anyone who wants a pet burun is in your fellow, since they only need to join your fellow prior to you killing the beacon. 
 Each person in your fellow must loot a crystal needle from the portal beacon. You can only take one. 
 Now use the needle to open the supply chest and loot your reward.

quests.title: Archon Intervention  I-V

quests._desc: Lupe has been having terrible dreams of late.
quests._walk:
Lupe tells you:
 "I have been disturbed by terrible dreams of late. I dream that I am lying cold beneath the earth.
I cannot wake, but I cannot sleep; neither can I move, nor lie still. I must know the meaning of these dreams and
how they can be stopped!
Please take this letter to the scholar Kiral in Rakani. She is skilled in the interpretation of dreams."
 Take the letter to Kiral in Rakani, who tells you:
 "Hmm... this is disturbing, Lupe's hunting must have angered the Ero-bals, restless spirits of long dead Tumeroks.
They torment her with visions of their own fate. Fortunately, we can protect her from their influences."
 Kiral gives you a Talisman and says:
 "While carrying this talisman, release 3 Ero-bals from their suffering -- it will absorb a bit of their spirits each time. 
Then return it to me" 
 Head to Ankoro and killed 3 Bals, 1 Khero and 2 Awaro, and returned to Kiral.
 Kiral tells you: 
 "Ah, excellent. I sense much rage and hatred in this Talisman.
But if we calm the spirits thus..."
 "The Talisman has been blessed with release. Tell Lupe to wear this around her neck,
and the angry spirits will no longer have influence over her dreams"
 Take the Talisman and give it to Lupe.
 Lupe tells you:
 "This is supposed to cure my bad dreams? It doesn't look like much of anything at all..."
"Oh... I can feel the evil influences draining away! I'm sure I'll sleep well tonight. Let me reward you 
for your time and effort. I owe you a favour, friend"

quests._desc: The Ascended Chaos Eidolon struggles blindly to escape the chaotic depths of portalspace and return to Auberean. If it succeeds, it will destroy us all. You must defeat this threat.
quests._walk:
Part 1: Omishan (lvl ~35)
 Easiest one, Look Around Sanctuary for Glimmers (Wisps). Have one person in your fellow kill 3 in the following Order:
 Deformed Glimmer
 Distorted Glimmer
 Contorted Glimmer 
 He will then recieve a Gem that will summon a portal to Omishan Master Vault. All Go there. 
 This place is a maze, loot the corpses for "Repairing Serums", Murky / Glimmering / Cyan, and use them on the 4 Crystals found throughout the dungeon. You will then be portaled to the boss room. 
 Kill the boss and retrieve the trophy from his corpse, a Hand Go through the portal that appears for your reward. 5k xp (I am lvl 56) and Crystalized Vitae of Omishan which is +15 luck for 10 mins once every 24 hours. 
 Part 2: Linvak (lvl ~40)
 Find the Gleams (Wisps) on the plains of Stone Shadow, get one member of your fellow to kill them in the following Order:
 Contorted Gleam
 Deformed Gleam
 Distorted Gleam 
 Use the portal and enter the dungeon, nothing two hard in here, find the 3 Power Conduits and destroy them, then find the portal to the boss room. 
 Dont forget to retrieve the Eye from the corpse. 
 Your reward is 50k (I'm lvl 56) and the Crystalized Vitae of Linvak, All healing spells cast on you are at lvl+5 for 10 mins once per day. 
 Part 3: Osteth (lvl ~55) 
 Find the Wisps in the area around the Ancient Crypt (esp along the NE beach), get one member of your fellow to kill them in the following Order:
 Deformed Wisp
 Distorted Wisp
 Contorted Wisp 
 Get in the dungeon, Proceed to the Accelorater, and use it to go up a level (select it and press F, takes a couple of tries to master), go straight on, collect a Shard if you wish, and use it in the next area to the south to disable some of the defences. Buff up and bring a strong fellow, the next fight is hard. 
 Kill all his helpers then the boss, dont forget to loot the Heart then proceed to the vault to get your reward, 40million xp and the Crystalized Vitae of Osteth, +50 to AR for 10 mins once per day (all Vitae's trigger the same "once per day" so only 1 per day) 
 Part 4: The Chaos Plane: 
 Return to Rytheryn and take the portal into the Chaos Plane, go down the stairs to the bottem, then take the SE route up, take the portal. 
 You are now in a flat sub area, take the portal to the south, its guarded only by solo mobs and if you read it is "slightly less dangerous", the other two are instant death. 
 Go up the stairs from here for ages till you get to another level, kill the 2 solo and 1 group mob at the base of the tower then climb the tower. 
 At the top of the tower hand each of the three trophies you got from the above stages to the chaos portal (be warned he will eat anything you hand him), this will unlock the portal and let you in. 
 You are now in the Final Boss Room. The Eidolon is lvl 65 with 350k health and a range of well over 5 rader rings, he also uses 5 min debuffs. Make your way around the ramp, you will encounter Chaos Stones (lvl 62, 57500 health). Destroy the Stones first as they have nasty AOEs, then kill the Eidolon.
Once he falls to the south of his corpse a chaos rift appears, you must touch it to complete the quest and get your rewards.

quests._desc: Rare artifacts can be imbued on weapons, armor, and shields for a powerful effect depending on the type of Mirra.
quests._walk:
Take the Mirra to the Water Temple Dungeon north of Mayoi (0.9N 44.7E). Once inside work your way down to the treasure chest. Behind the chest are 3 obelisks. 
 Use the obelisks in the following order (as you face them):
 Center
 Left
 Center
 Left
 Right
 Left
 Right
 Center
 Left
 Left
 Right
 Center
 After each touch, you should hear a faint clicking noise. If you don't, start over at center obelisk. 
When you complete the pattern, you will be portaled to a fountain guarded by a Guardian of the Sacred Waters. 
 Place the Mirra in the fountain to cleanse it.
 NOTE: Also the Sacred font inside the Catacombs of Artefon will cleanse the mirra. Although it is recommended that you use the Sacred Waters of the water temple dungeon since it is much easier to access. 
 You then receive a quest to find a way to improve a peice of armor or a weapon with the Mirra. You can skip the Exelaris, but the effect is only 50% of what it would be if you get it charged at the Shrine of Exelaris.
 Then you must take the Mirra to the Shrine of Exelaris (32.2s 44.5w SW of Guroka)
 The Mirra now becomes charged.
 Warning: Do not place the loaded Mirra into the font again it will be destroyed.
 Decide if you want to imbue a weapon or armor with the mirra then take it to the appropriate NPC. 
 Armor, and Shields: Take the mirra to Darvain Geddon, west of the E. Vesayan Outpost (10.2N, 89.1E). Hand him the Mirra, then the item you want imbued. He will improve the item with the Mirra you handed him

quests._desc: Lodrog the Foresaken wants you to uncover lost peices of Gurog lore inside the Undercrofts of Goarata.
quests._walk:
Head to the King of the Mountain (Easiest way is to go to Arramora and take the portal to Linvak). Once you kill the King of the Mountain a portal appears to the Goarata Undercrofts.
 Inside the dungeon piles of rock and debris are scattered about. You must sift through these with your satchel to find the peices (use satchel like a key), when you are successful your quest panel will update. Tip: The piles you want have a pink glow. You must find five peices of lore:
 Scroll of the beginning 
While the characters are difficult to make out, the few phrases reveal that this is a scrap of the Gurog Scroll of Beginning. The phrases read:
 "... we, though not born of this world, came to be born on it... through the art of others we came to be... we, once unthinking... without past, now gifted with thought and memory... strange birth... our masters, who cared for us, now our teachers..."
 Cronicles of the first Chief 
The characters are badly blurred by age and moisture, but the phrases you can read reveal that these are the Chronicles of the First Chief. The phrases read:
 "...High Chief... friend of Kresovus... guided us... ways of the blade and smith... "
 Legres' Treatise 
The words, written in a stiff, crabbed hand, indicate that this is a fragment of Legres' Treatise. The words read:
 "... strange to think how far we've advanced in the scant... years of the life of our race... advances in ways of magic... Lord Asheron demonstrated..."
 Annals of Goarata 
While there are but a few words written on the page, the crisp, formal nature of the characters reveal that this is a scrap from the Annals of Goarata. The words read:
 "...In the 30th year since the Beginning, Bloodhorn, son of... commissioned the building of a great fortress. This fortress was to be called "Goarata," in honor of..."
 Bloodhorn Journal 
The sheet of paper seems to be a page from Bloodhorn's Journal. The page reads:
 "Verdatine 3, 72 P.Y. --As the day's light dimmed, a shadowy figure appeared at the gates of Goarata today. The figure said it represented a great power, and this power wished to arrange an audience with the Chief of the Gurog. I have agreed to this meeting.
Father said we should fear the darkness, but one never gained power by living in fear. It was not by living in fear that I united those who rebelled against him under one banner. I shall meet this power and see what it has to say."
 Work your way around inside until you find them all. Use this map by Mikomi to help you:
Map Edited by Fiona Pendragon to show the spawn locations of the debris piles.
 Once you have found all 5 peices return to lodrog for your reward.

quests._desc: The Olthoi have created an egg chamber that needs to be destroyed to slow down this growing menace.
quests._walk:
Once at the surface kill the Adult Olthoi Gardners that spawn around the portal. 
They drop a Olthoi Scent Gland .
 A Feral Intendant must then use one of these to create Olthoi Scent Gland lining 
Note: this component only lasts 2 hours before it must be used or it will be destroyed.
 A sage then uses these to make Purified Olthoi Scent Vial 
Note: this potion only lasts 2 hours before it must be used or it will be destroyed.
 You then need an alchemist to use the potion. He will then get a new recipe to create "Diluted Olthoi Scent Potion".
 Diluted Olthoi Scent Potion Recipe:
 1 Alchemist vial (destroyed during the craft)
 1 Purified Olthoi Scent Vial
This one recipe creates 9 Diluted Olthoi Scent Potions . 
Note: this potion only lasts 30 mins before it must be used or it wil be destroyed.
 Each person then uses the vial which gives them the Olthoi Scent quest. Note: this quest is just to grant you access inside the catacombs, and the egg chamber.
You then enter the portal to the Olthoi Catacombs. Make your way down and locate the Egg Chamber, its entrance portal randomly spawns in the dungeon so its not often in the same location. Once you go through the portal you will recieve the "Bringing Down the Catacombs" quest.
Within the egg chamber (which is a HUGE room) there are six massive pillars supporting the cavern, they have 100,000 life each and must be destroyed,
The cavern is swarming with olthoi, and more spawn with the destruction of each pillar.
When all of the pillars are destroyed, the cavern starts to collapse! It's basically a DoT with lots of nice crashing animations. A portal appears in the cavern for you to exit before you are crushed under the falling rock.
 The portal leads back to Teltawa, upon speaking with him you will finish the Bringing down the Catacombs quest and receive your reward.

Head to the Burun Clutch at 24.4n, 72.7e (South of Ankoro). 
Go inside and make all right turns, you will then come to red floating portal, once you portal in go into the main chamber were the brood mother is. Once inside the hidden room you need to steal the Blood Fetish.

quests._desc: You must help begin a cleansing ritual of Omishan.
quests._walk:
You must first seek out a Tumerok of pure spirit. 
 Takethe wand to Akkilea in Zu, once he gives the wand his blessing return it to Amano-Bal.
 You must now visit the Tumerok Shrines throughout omishan and hand them the wand for their blessing:
 Palenqual (Northeast Ariaki 18.5N 53.4) 
 Volkama (Northeast Naderu 37.8N 62.2E) 
 Tanea (Hakata 3.2N 85.6E) 
 Mother Aundetanga (Northeast Naderu 32.4N 66.1E) 
 Great Sister Rain (Sanctuary 4.8S 93.6E) 
 Sister Wind (Rakani 26.6N, 58.5E) 
 Black Mother Earth (Ikeras 13.5N 61.0E) 
 Blue Mother Heaven (Southern Tou Tou 8.5N, 65.8E)
 Hazahtu, The Blind Eye (NorthwestNaderu 32.6N 50.5E) 
 Ezereth, Great father Sea (Shinoko 7.2s 72.4E) 
 Shrine to Wharu (Eastern Kydi 10.2N 46.0E) 
The Wharu shrine rejects the wand. Return the wand and Amano-Bal tells you to find a ritual object of Wharu.
 You must then head to 22.5n 57.0e (Northwest Tou Tou) and enter the Dungeon.
Once inside you must collect 4 colored keys before you go on through the doors. On the floors of the dungeon are barrels of food, walking near one heals you for 100. Use the 4 colored keys on the 4 doors and proceed to the boss chamber and kill the Burun Shaman, and loot the Wharu Fetish, and the Red Fire Cesta.
 Return the Fetish to Amano-Bal to complete the quest.

quests._desc: Eshivon Ugin wants you to bring him Arcanum items lost through the ages.
quests._walk:
Return these items to Eshivon Ugin:
 Arcanum Scroll 
 Arcanum Codex 
 Arcanum Book 
 Arcanum Tome 
The items are found inside Arcanum Caches throughout Dereth. To find out more about Arcanum caches read the Arcanum Cache Guide.
 There is a book inside the Arcanum Vault, here is what it says:
There is a book inside called Of Arcanum Caches this is what is written:
 " Of Arcanum Caches 
 We of the Arcanum leave this Vault and this Book as gifts to whatever future generation may find them.
Seeing the horror that was upon us, with the Hopeslayer once more set loose, we of the Arcanum have scattered our vast stores of knowledge and artifacts in secret caches throughout Dereth. It is our hope that this will preserve some fragment of our wisdom -- wisdom that you can use to restore this world.Contained in this, the only book we left behind in the Vault, are the secrets of these caches and the means of revealing them.
 Of Caches 
 Each cache contains arms, armor, and other artifacts from our treasuries. Each cache also contains a work from our libraries, as knowledge is more important than any artifact. These caches have been scattered near towns and other sites throughout Dereth. The location of each cache has been recorded in a reckoning gem, hundreds of which lie within this Vault.To uncover a cache, you will need to use the correct gem in close proximity to its hidden location. The gem will reveal the dig point for the cache and dissolve, having served its purpose. If you are not at the proper location, the gem will indicate the direction you need to travel.
Although the reckoning gem will lead you to a dig point, you cannot simply dig up the cache. Wards have been set around each cache to prevent its contents from falling into the wrong hands. In addition, our Lugian members have constructed hundreds of Minions, creatures of rock and stone based on the ancient Empyrean golems, to protect each cache. To defeat these defenders, you will need to use a Recondite Machine to disable the alarm wards.
 Of Recondite Machines 
 A Recondite Machine is a complex mechanism that disables the wards disguising a cache and neutralizes the hidden Minions protecting it. It is imperative that the machine be of the highest quality, or it may fail to reveal the cache.Worse, a faulty machine may activate all of a cache's Minion protectors.
To construct a Recondite Machine, you will need th...

Of Arcanum Caches 
 We of the Arcanum leave this Vault and this Book as gifts to whatever future generation may find them.
Seeing the horror that was upon us, with the Hopeslayer once more set loose, we of the Arcanum have scattered our vast stores of knowledge and artifacts in secret caches throughout Dereth. It is our hope that this will preserve some fragment of our wisdom -- wisdom that you can use to restore this world.Contained in this, the only book we left behind in the Vault, are the secrets of these caches and the means of revealing them.
 Of Caches 
 Each cache contains arms, armor, and other artifacts from our treasuries. Each cache also contains a work from our libraries, as knowledge is more important than any artifact. These caches have been scattered near towns and other sites throughout Dereth. The location of each cache has been recorded in a reckoning gem, hundreds of which lie within this Vault.To uncover a cache, you will need to use the correct gem in close proximity to its hidden location. The gem will reveal the dig point for the cache and dissolve, having served its purpose. If you are not at the proper location, the gem will indicate the direction you need to travel.
Although the reckoning gem will lead you to a dig point, you cannot simply dig up the cache. Wards have been set around each cache to prevent its contents from falling into the wrong hands. In addition, our Lugian members have constructed hundreds of Minions, creatures of rock and stone based on the ancient Empyrean golems, to protect each cache. To defeat these defenders, you will need to use a Recondite Machine to disable the alarm wards.

 A Recondite Machine is a complex mechanism that disables the wards disguising a cache and neutralizes the hidden Minions protecting it. quests._desc: Reckoning gems are found throughout the land, these gems lead to hidden caches. These caches contain treasure, and Arcanum items.
quests._walk:
Now that you have the device to disable the wards of a cache you need to find one. To do so you need to find a:
 Reckoning Gem 
These gems are a semi rare drop from monsters on all continents, the name of the gem is the location of the cache. If you cannot figure out the AC1 terminology take the gem to Eshivon Ugin, he will tell you were to look.
 Once you get in the region were you need to be simply use the gem, it will pull you in the direction were the cache is hidden. Watch the description of the strength of the pull to determine how far off you are. For example "Violently wrenchs your hand to the north" means its far north, and "slightly tugging" means your very close.
 Keep zeroing in until you uncover the dig point.
 Important Note: Once revealed you have only 5 minutes to use the Recondite Machine to uncover the cache.
 Use the Recondite Machine on the dig point. This will reveal the cache, and grant you a quest that allows you to open it. Also it will spawn 2-5 Minions that will attack as soon as spawned.
 Once the Minions are destroyed loot the cache.
 The Arcanum Items inside the chests can be used in the Recover the Arcanum's Library quest.
