quests._desc: In the chaos planes a long lost power has been found. Cleanse it, and many rewards are yours.
quests._walk:
Speak with the Hammer of Light, it has many pauses so you need to continue clicking on it to continue the story. The Hammer of Light tells you:
 "Greetings, hero. I am the spirit of the Hammer of Light. Listen well to my words, if you would hear a tale of the ancient dawn of Dereth, a tale which began in the elder days that came before mortals were summoned to Auberean, and has not come to an end even in this debased epoch."
 "In ancient times, the lords of Light created me as living artifact. They intended to forge items of virtue and power for the greatest of their children. The most powerful of the Empyrean smiths wielded me, and I learned wisdom in their hands. But after many ages passed, the children abandoned their heritage, and the divergent Empyrean tribes lost the way to my Forge."
 "For eons I languished. The lords of Light turned their countenance away from their foolish children, and the children forgot the wisdom of their forebears. Down through the generations the great Forge of Light was abandoned, unused, hidden, and silent. But then something changed, and I woke from the sleep of ages."
 "The entities you call the Virin'di discovered my hiding place. They overcame the ancient wards, and carried me off to a hidden retreat in portalspace where they slowly began to build the great machine they would call the Forge of the Dominion. They erected powerful defenses against the children of Light while they attempted to discover my secrets. In time, over many hundreds of years, they slowly learned to create items of power of their own for their mortal followers. Yet they reckoned not with the forces of Shadow."
 "The sensitive perception of the one you call Bael'Zharon eventually detected my influence in portalspace. The Virin'di of that age had no defenses against the awesome Shadow magic of the Hopeslayer which he thrust beyond the angles of the world into the heart of portalspace."
 "The Virin'di researchers working on the Forge of the Dominion were quickly overcome by the Shadow onslaught. Their connection to their great Singularity was severed, and without that font of power, they were no match for their attackers. Yet just when victory seemed to be in the hands of the attackers, a last Virin'di Inquisitor, already half-insane due to its disjunction from the Quiddity, managed to wield me as a weapon against the Shadow foe."
 "Never in an age of ages had I been used as a weapon. The awesome power of the lords of Light, wielded without understanding by a demented servant of the Singularity, smashed the Shadows, broke enchantments, shattered minds, and brought down the very walls of reality."
 "This region of portalspace was severed from the primary continuum. Like water breaking through a ruptured dam, raw Chaos flooded through the Forge portals from sources beyond the walls of the world. Most of the Shadows and Virin'di present were destroyed, either by the primary onslaught of the Hammer or the secondary effects of the raging tide of Chaos. A few shattered and twisted beings still haunt this region, along with the primal manifestations of Chaos which came from Outside."
 "Over a few fleeting hundreds of years, the Forge of the Dominion has become a Chaos Forge. Since the efflux of Chaos, this region of portalspace has been isolated... until now. Something has happened to reconnect this region to a more traveled part of the continuum. I have no knowledge of what has transpired outside. My knowledge of the current state of affairs is very limited."
 "I only know one thing.... I am no longer the Hammer of Light..."
 "... I am now the Hammer of Chaos! Forgive me, mortal, but I cannot control my actions. A force I cannot name requires that I send you to a place prepared for your destruction. Please... if you survive... forgive me... Free me from my bondage, purify the Chaos Forge, and I will serve you if I can."
You are teleported to another dungeon.
 Platform One (Red) 
 When you were teleported in to this dungeon members of your party may have been split up and sent to one of the other 4 landing points. This platform has many Chaos Golems, and Furious Chaos Wisps so be careful. Make your way to the center of the platform, there is a segment of false floor so do not try jumping, instead go around. Once in the middle kill the Uplifted Chaos Golem.
Once it it is slain the fellowship who was credited with the kill will be teleported to Platform Two.
 Platform Two (Yellow) 
 This platform has many Chaos Golems, and Furious Chaos Wisps. Make your way to the center of the platform. Once in the middle kill the Ascended Chaos Golem.
Once it it is slain the fellowship who was credited with the kill will be teleported to Platform Three.
 Platform Three (Green) 
 This platform has lots of Furious Chaos Wisps, and just a few Chaos Golems. Make your way to the center of the platform. Once in the middle kill the Resplendent Chaos Golem.
Once it it is slain the fellowship who was credited with the kill will be teleported to Platform Four.
 Platform Four (Blue) 
 This sprial platform is regarded as the hardest because the landing is not safe and all the Furious Chaos Wisps can attack you without you being able to hit them unless you have range, there are also Chaos Golems in here. Make your way to the center of the platform. Once in the middle kill the Exalted Chaos Golem.
Once it it is slain the fellowship who was credited with the kill will be teleported to Platform Five, the final Platform.
 Platform Five (Violet) 
 This is the last Platform. There are many Chaos Golems, and Furious, and Raging Chaos Wisps so use extreme caution. Make your way to the center of the platform past the portal (Do not go in yet!). Once in the middle kill the Supreme Chaos Golem.
Once it is slain any fellow can use the Chaos Rift to close the rift, and advance their quest, the chaos rift WILL respawn again soon, and another fellow can use to advance their quest (When the Supreme Golem Respawns no one can use the rift). Once you have used the Rift go through the portal. It returns you back to the hammer.
 Speak with the Hammer of Light again:
 "Thank you, hero, for purging the taint of chaos from this place. I fear that the dire influence may yet return, but for the moment, I am at your service."
 "I am forbidden to communicate some of the more advanced techniques employed by my various ancient masters, but there are several elementary operations which may yet be of interest."
 "First of all, if you have armor forged according to the strictures of the Radiant Temple, I can upgrade those pieces. Simply place the pieces in the forge and they will be enchanted anew."
"Secondly, you may forge an entire new suit of Augmented Kingdom armor here. Begin by placing a huge pyreum gem into the forge, and I will then communicate the subsequent steps required to forge the new suit of armor."
 "Finally, even if you are not affiliated with a Kingdom, you can use the forge to create the relic known as the Star of Heroes. Place a crystalline artifact of chaos in the forge, and I will transform it."
 Rewards:
 60,000,000XP
 Upgraded Kingdom Armor 
 Hand the forge existing Kingdom Armor to get a free upgrade of your Kingdom Armor to Augmented Kingdom Armor.
You can hand in imbued or unimbued armor. Also if you have Kingdom Armor that is no longer of your kingdom you can hand them in and get the Augmented armor of your faction.
 WARNING: Augmented Kingdom Armor requires 92 Arcane Lore to equip, and any crystal imbues on the peice will be lost.
 Upgraded Armor Stats: 
 Breastplate 132ar
 Pants 81ar
 Helm 32 (With Magic Defense) 
 Gloves 32ar (With Melee Defense) 
 Boots 32ar (With Missle Defense) 
 Hero Star 
 Hand the forge either of these items to recieve a star of heros. You can Hand the Star of Heroes into the Hero Shrine on Arramora to gain Arramora recal.
Important Note: You do not need to be in a kingdom to get this reward!
 Attuned Chaos Crystal (Reward for Defeating the Chaos Eidolon)
 Chaos Power Crystal (Item from the last part of Natures Ally Quest) 
 Complete set of Augmented Kingdom Armor 
 To create the Armor you must give the Forge:
 Huge Pyreum gemstone
 Chaos Essence which restores lost health
 5 Ebon Pyreals
 100,000 coins
 Crystal charged with chaos power.
 Augmented Kingdom Armor Stats: 
 Breastplate 132ar
 Pants 81ar
 Helm 32 (With Magic Defense) 
 Gloves 32ar (With Melee Defense) 
 Boots 32ar (With Missle Defense)

quests._desc: The White Rabbit, also known as "Pookie Destroyer of Worlds" is found inside Lahrys Garden SE of Cragstone at 29.6N 7.8W. You must stop this menace.
quests._walk:
Go inside the dungeon and work your way down into the garden, towards the lair of the beast. Once you come to a set of doors, prepare for battle by killing the small rabbits around the door. If you have the Requiescat, simply use it, and you will get a targeting recticle to select the weapon you want the imbue on. It imbues a weapon with the White Rabbit Slayer effect, it will do 1 million damage in a single strike. 
 Once your weapon is ready to go, charge in through the doors and strike down the white rabbit, if your unsuccesful in your attempt, you must return swiftly because the slayer effect only lasts 30 minutes on your weapon.
 Once you have slain the White Rabbit, its corpse will be placed in your pack. Take this back to the surface and hand it to Lahry.
If your in a fellowship, only the person credited with the kill receives the reward.
 He will in turn hand you the Staff, or Drum of bunny booty. And then he will announce to the server of your amazing feat.

quests._desc: The Burun and Olthoi have been spotted working together, you must find out more about this new threat.
quests._walk:
Make your way to Conceled Portal (Hakata 11.2N 80.2E). 
Go inside the Conceled Portal Dungeon and loot an Amber Pendant from any Burun inside. Return the Amber pandant to Tuamoa, and you are told it is used as some sort of key.
 Next head to the the Ancient Burun Idol (Hakata 11.7N 80.0E) and hand in the Amber Pendant, this will teleport all fellow members inside the Omishan Idol dungeon. Inside you must loot an Amber Orb off of the Burun Shaman Hivemaster boss.
Return the Amber pandant to Tuamoa, he will tell you:
"Yes... this is clearly an item of great power. Most of its capabilities are mysterious to me, but I believe this item can also be used to open a sealed portal... Hmm... let me attempt to trace the power lines... Yes, someplace on Arramora you may be able to find the lock to which this is the key. I am sensing trees, insects, moisture... the location you must seek next is in the heart of the jungle."
 Now you must travel to Arramora and go to the Ancient Burun Idol (14.4N 51.6W) and hand in the Amber Orb, this will teleport all fellow members inside the Arramora Idol dungeon.
Make your way to the south in this area towards the large Cathedral styled room. Take the ramp up, then head around the ramp the the NW side. On the far side of the room from the ramp is a hall leading to the Burun Immortal Grandmaster. He is accompanied by an Olthoi Soldier(level 74, 10k health), Olthoi Drones, and Grubs.
Kill the Burun Immortal Grandmaster, he drops the Lyceana Staff and the Burun Immortals Journal. Take Journal back to Tuamoa. (read the Burun Immortal's Journal here ) 
 Note: You must kill again for every member in your fellowship who wants a staff. The respawn time is 2-3 minutes.
 Hand the Burun Immortals Journal to Tuamoa:
"Well done! This journal is just what I need to convince the war-leaders to pay heed to the new Burun threat. Thank you for your diligence, hero. I cannot offer you much in reward, but I have gleaned a little knowledge from the artifacts you found. If you give me a weapon, I can provide an enchantment that will empower it to slay Olthoi."
You can then hand him the weapon of your choice to be imbued:
"Very well, I have enchanted your weapon. Thank you again for your assistance, hero!"
 Warning Rare Bug: In very rare cases if more than one person hands in a weapon to be imbued the NPC will not return your weapon, please ensure no more than one person at a time hand in a weapon. Admins cannot replace lost items.

quests.title: Fanboi

quests._desc: Jomers pump is broken, find a way to fix it!
quests._walk:
After speaking with him use the Olvidan Well to receive broken pump.
Take pump to Miller of Kehan in Kehan town.
Give Ferrous Pyreal to advance quest.
 The Miller needs one Anthracite gem.
To get the Anthracite gem do the following:
 Use a Flowering Bush (found north of Rakani) to recieve a Withered Blossom, keep collecting these until you have 8.
 Give 1 Withered Blossom to the Shrine of Black Mother Earth (Ikeras: 13.5N, 61.0E). You will recieve a recipe for a Garland that requires seven Withered Blossoms. 
 Craft the Garland of Flowers and return it to the Shrine. You recieve a Scented Blossom. 
 Find the Outcast Wasp Queen at (Cragstone: 35.8N 13.9W). Give it the Blossom, you will receive a Cluster of Wasp Eggs in return. 
 Find the Digger Dillo Mama at (Rithwic: 25.0N 5.4E). Give it the Eggs, you will receive a Succulent Truffle in return. 
 Find the Grutt Gourmand at (Rithwic: 21.2N 2.1E). Give it the Truffle, you will get a stack of eight Anthracite Gems in return.
 Receive fixed pump from Miller of Kehan
Give pump to well, then talk to Jomer Olvidan to complete the quest.

quests.title: Wild Hare

quests._desc: Matto Olvidans crops are being ruined by the black mucoor light, find a way to rid his crops of this plague.
quests._walk:
Talk to Adesar the Mushroom collector (Ankoro 28.6N, 71.8E).
Adesar the Mushroom collector tells you, "Black mucor blight? That's a horrible
disease, all right. Fortunatly I know a cure... the first step is to prepare some
dark syrup. I'll need a black dye plant for that which I will prepare with my secret
herbs and spices." 
 Turn in black plant to Adesar
Adesar the Mushroom Collector tells you, "Excellent. Here is the dark syrup you'll
need. All right, now you need to find a mucor mushroom. Splash some dark syrup on it
and it will exude a sort of slime.... Collect some of the slime and bring it back." 
You recieve Dark Syrup from Adesar "This thick syrup smells foul. To try to smear it
on something, double click on the syrup and select a suitable target." 
 Find a Mucor Mushroom.
Use Dark Syrup on Mushroom.
You receive Mucor Slime in backpack.
Give Mucor Slime to Adesar the Mushroom collector he tells you: "Phew, that stuff is foul, isn't it? All right then... a few pinches of this and
that from my own stores... and there you go. Black Mucor Blight Cure. Just apply it
to the black mucor excrescense, and you should be all set." 
 You recieve the Black Mucor Blight Cure, a loathsome mixture said to be effective
against the blight.
 Go back to field and use on Mucors in field
Once advanced go talk to Matto to complete the quest.

quests.title: Green Thumb

quests._desc: Silia has lost her engagement ring, help her find it!
quests._walk:
Speak with Almahara Olvidan, she tells you, "Poor Silia! Lost her ring! I never! Well, I have
something here you might be able to use to get it back, it just needs a little work,
is all. here is my old dowsing rod. Problem is, the seeking crystal is broke, but if
you can find a new one, you mjight be able to fix it right up." 
 You receive "Disfunctional Dowsing Rod" - A notched stick that seems to be missing
something. To attach the missing component, double-click on the stick and select the
compnent"
 Locate a quartz crystal (gem)
 Use the rod on a quartz crystal. (Advance)
The rod turns into Dowsing Rod - Quest reads- Find the ring with the dowsing rod.
Use rod - Indicators are like using a Reckoning gem to locate Lugian Engagement
Ring.
 Locate ring and you get an advance. Rod disappears and ring appears in your pack.
Lugian Engagement Ring - A heavy gold ring.
Give ring to Silia Olvidan to complete quest.

quests.title: Carrot-Eating Freaks

quests._walk:
Head to Northern Oriad Outpost (Whitebay) and run east to 13.0S, 5.5W. 
Inside, going straight will lead you to the surface exit and going left will take you on your way to the Wasp Breeder. For a few level 40 classes this dungeon might be a little tough but by 42 it should be doable by anyone. The Wasp Breeder is protected by a few onyx wasps at the bottom of the dungeon, but can can be drawn out with a ranged weapon. Kill him and loot the Onyx Honeycomb. Take the honeycomb back to Stubby in East Gevoth for your reward and he tells you this: "Wow, this is some powerful honey. I think the Wasp Breeder was up to a little bit more then we originally anticipated. Thanks for slaying him. If you would like to continue to help control the Onyx Wasp population, kill the wasps and bring me back their wings as proof. My pockets are small so I can only take one wing per hour." 
Each wing turned in will yield a 25,000 XP reward.

quests._desc: You must find Isin Dule and free him.
quests._walk:
Use Naokims Portal Device to be transported into the prison of despair.
 Head into the cell block area. Make your way to the back and go into the garbage chute portal. There you will find the warder's key, pick it up and go in the portal, return to the main hall. Go into the Warders room, steal his book, and a key.
 Go to the cell block area. Go into Cellblock B2, look for a key. once you have a key make your way into the next cell clock area you can go into until you find the captains key.
take the captains key to the Barracks to open the door to get the interrogation key.
 Go into the interrogation to loot another key. Make your way to the secure portal near the entrance, go in the first portal, once inside go left.
 Go down the stairs and use the lock pedestal to receive the key sequence number. Touch the pillars in sequence depending on what key the pedestal gives you.
Key, and Pillar Sequence
 Key 1: 123455
 Key 2: 223315
 Key 3: 444441
 Key 4: 246426
 Key 5: 535362
 Key 6: 165432
(Image of the lock pedestal room)
Once you complete the sequence use the lock pillar again to receive an invisible key to unlock the Hazardous Prisoner Containment door.
Go down into the Hazardous Prisoner Containment and destroy the Stone of Binding. It will summon Stones of Smiting, little bloodstones that have group monster stats. 
 Kill the Stone of Binding and loot the Portal Gem of Despair.
Return the Gem to Naokim, then go into his portal device.
 Go though the dungeon portal. Head back and speak with Black Ferah. She sends you to another dungeon. Make your way through, and find 3 keys. Then make your way to the three doors. Once you have gone through the doors, speak with Black Ferah. She dissapears, and you get a quest advance. As she disappears she summons Shadows, you must kill them and loot a key. Your quest panel should say "Find Black Ferah, and defeat her at last". If it does not say this, speak with her when she reappears. Once you get quest advance go into the portal. Behind your landing is Isin Dules cell. Head South until you encounter Black Ferah.
 Black Ferah has four forms, each time you kill her she returns in a more powerfull form. After you kill the last incarnation loot the Oubliette key from her, and free Isin dule.
 Note: If you dont get advance when killing the final Black Ferah, ensure your quest panel says: "Find Black Ferah, and defeat her at last" 
If you dont have this, run back through the dungeon and speak with the final Black Ferah NPC.
 Isin Dule Tells you:
 ""So... the time has come at last. With the defeat of Black Ferah, the spell that holds me here has been broken. I must leave immediately to seek out certain power sources that must be protected, but until I return to Dereth, know that you have my thanks for your great deeds. I will remember your names, heroes!" 
Return to Naokim to receive your Ort reward.

quests.title: Search for Isin Dule II

quests._walk:
Head to the first Thusik Rigway (3.1 S x 18.9 W).
Look for a corpse of an explorer near those coords. Loot a key. 
Open the chest at 3.1s x 18.9w. inside the chest you will find a Theolodite and notebook. 
Use the theolodite like a reckoning gem. It will spawn a beacon, Protect the beacon from Gruesome Vermin, and Abysmal Armoredillo. After a few minutes, beacon will spawn a portal. Enter the portal and head south in the dungeon till you can go no farther, then head east to boss (Nexi lvl 63 150k HP) 
 Once Nexi is dead, a portal rupture will open to the Cachaphos. Work your way to the top of the mountain.
Once at the top, There is an entrance into the side of the mountain, enter the side of the mountain and go into the Heart of the Cacophos dungeon. 
Once inside the Cacophos dungeon you should find 5 seals, these seals weaken the final boss (so the more you get the easier the fight). Make your way down inthe dungeon until you find "The Edge" Portal. Once inside the final boss chamber wait for the boss and the protecting stones to appear. Use the seals on stones on the outer rim of the platform, simply double click the seal and use it on the correspondingly named stone, this will weaken the beast. You must destroy The Beast of Cacophos lvl 70 350k HP (Spawn).
 Defeat the boss and return to Theotor. He will give you a robe and a key to use on one of the nearby chests. If you run this quest from start to finish you should get 2 keys, but reports of this varies, they stack to make sure to separate them.
Use the key to open on of Theotors chest.
 ( Warning!: Make sure no one is using the chest you use your key on or you will loose your key! These chests do not open like normal chests, there is no animation to see if its currently in use. So make sure no one is standing nearby.) 
Inside the chest is a jewel, you can use up to 3 of them on the robe to upgrade it.

quests._desc: Something is up with the S.H.R.E.T.H. activity in the area, find out whats going on.
quests._walk:
After you talk to Justiciar, head on over to Arramora to hunt down the SHRETH District Manager: a lvl 60, solo-statted, randomly spawning monster. Hunt him down to get a SHRETH courier package. Take this package to the Frozen Ravine (in East Gevoth, 9.9S, 54.7W).
 Give the package to the SHRETH Secret Underground Base Door Guard. He will return the package to you and allow you and your group to portal into the SHRETH Secret Undeground Base (this isn't a quest advance, but it flags the guard to portal you into the dungeon, so have your fellow picked out by this time).
 Now take your time to explore this hilarious dungeon. Note, that all the SHRETH monsters don't automatically fight you. After all, you're incognito in their base. So you can choose not to fight the monsters in here, but the instant you do, you get an Alarm effect that lasts for 4 hours that causes you to be aggro'd by all the monsters in there (complete with Shreth that spawn right out of the walls). 
 Search the dungeon until you find the SHRETH Bursar and give him the courier package. He will give you the Decoder ring. 
 Now that you have the ring, head to the Commander's offices where you will find Number Two: a lvl 80, group statted monster. Attack him and he will flee (literally, you could just craft a starter bow and prick him), leaving things to the SHRETH Base Commander: a lvl 66, group statted monster (he's an alchy class with grenades, so watch the AOEs). But as Number Two leaves, he drops the Coded Document. Pick up this document, this document is attuned. 
 Picking up the Coded Document will be your first quest advance in the entire quest. Using the Decoder Ring on the Coded Document will give you the second. Return the decoded document to Justiciar to get your reward.

quests._desc:
Stubby tells you:
"My cousin Thromer recently ran off to become the new Virindi Imperator. Hey, is that a good thing? Anyway, being the nice guy that he is, he left me his prized herd of Dillos. I just love Dillos -- I used to help Thromer take care of them when I was little. They're so cute! But I guess I've been too busy collecting wasp wings lately, and Dillos take a lot of attention... I'm afraid my new Dillos have gotten sick with some kind of disease that makes them crazy! There's only one person who could help -- my old buddy Moose Rickenson. DO whatever he says, and I'm sure my Dillos will be better in no time. Let me know as soon as you manage to cure them. Oh, yeah, they're located at 17.9S, 18.6W. Please don't hurt any of them! Especially Golas!".
quests._walk:
Anyone who has done the Boots quest or has walked through Ondekodo knows who Moose Im the cock of the walk Rickenson is, but for those few who do not, he is located in Ondekodo at (19.6S,31.2W). Visit Moose and he tells you:
 "So, you have some sick Dillos. Well, you came to the right place. It sounds like your herd has Crazy Dillo Fever. Any herder knows that if your dillos have a fever, the only prescription is more Dillobell. Bring me some Reaper Horns and I should be able to slap one together. And don't fear the Reapers! They're not all that tough. You can find a bunch of 'em on Osteth." 
 Ok. Moose wants reaper horns, we need to go to Osteth and hunt up some reapers. One good spot to hunt is Near the Eastern Prosper Outpost, but there are many places with reapers. Pain Reapers and Grim Reapers drop horns regularly.
 When youve found some Reaper Horns, return to Moose and give them to him. He tells you:
 "Nice -- I see the Reapers didn't scare you one bit! Here's your Dillobell. Listen, I put my kilt on like the rest of you, one leg at a time. The difference is, once my kilt is on, I make gold Dillobells! Unfortunately, my bells don't make much sound... they can be used to cure your sick dillos, though. Perhaps someone in Dereth knows how to make them sound great. Really explore the space, you know?" 
 You now should have a Dillobell in your pack so get on your favorite mount and run on over to the Olvidan Farm at (17.9S, 18.6W). You will see 4 named dillos running around inside a big fenced in area. Your quest guide should tell you which to heal fisrt. Easier said than done. You need to get close enough to click the Dillobell and then click on them while they are trying to run quite quickly away from you. I found a trick on one of the forums that helped which is done by double-clicking the Dillobell, then running close to the desired dillo and then hitting the backspace key (the default Target Closest Monster Key). Anyway, watch out for the nasty dillo. He doesnt do much damage but is really annoying. I dont know what happens if you kill him, but since Stubby owns him too, I imagine he wont be too happy if you do.
 Once you have healed all 3 of Stubbys dillos, go back and talk to Stubby. He will tell you:
 "I can't thank you enough for helping my sick Dillos. I hope Golas didn't give you too hard of a time -- he can get a little feisty. Thromer thanks you too, wherever he is. Hey, is that a Dillobell? Can I see it?" 
 Give the Dillobell to Stubby and he says:
 "Hey, I remember these things! You just have to bend them the right way, and they sound great. There's nothing like a good Dillobell solo to set yer feet to dancin'! Here, give it a try!" 
 And Voila, you get a cool Dillobell instrument to wow your fellow musicians with.

quests._walk:
After talking to him you get a quest (under weapons you will now have a new section right above practice recipe, Quest recipe) to make a Basic Gearknight Sword: 100 iron 50 steel 150 wood 150 hide and an Unknown Dark Alloy (ebon pyreal) Forgot to look at the difficulty for that one but i got it on the first try.
 After you craft the sword you give it to Ludward. You then get a recipe for an Excellent Gear Knight Sword: 400 iron 100 steel 400 stone 400 chitin and Unknown Honing Oil (paper flesh) with a difficulty of 120.
 Give this sword to Ludward and he gives you a map that will lead you to a rusting Gear Knight in northern osteth. You must have a skill rating of at least 50 in survey to use the map. I gave mine to Martin Longbow who used it for me. The map works like a survey map. Once you get to the right location a local area broadcast message says "Martin Longbow brushes back the dirt and finds a rusting Gear Knight relic. A Gear Knight spring appeared in his pack and he gave it to me. 
 Give the spring to Ludward and then he gives it back to you and you get a recipe for a Gear Knight Spring: 500 Dramastic 500 Tukalite Unknown Crystaline Element (Osteth Vitae crystal) Unknown Chaotic Element (Chaos Essence) and the Rusting Gear Knight Spring, Difficulty 180. Took me about 5 tries before I suceeded. I was using a flat hammer and The Ulkas Blue ring (SoA) which buffed my weapon skill to 115.
 Quest is finished after turning in the New Gear Knight Spring to Ludward.
 Note: There are 4 different versions of this quest so far depending on what type of crafter you are. There is a version for weapon crafters, toolmakers, armorers, and spellbinding.
Each version has unique items you need to craft with a missing component, they are only hinted at, you must figure out what the last componente is. Here is a list so far.
 Unique Components 
 Weapon 
 Unknown Dark Alloy = Ebon Pyreal

quests._walk:
After entering you go left and jump down to the platform
with portal on your right. You're end up in the Virindi Maze where
you'll have to get 5 buffs (yellow, red, blue, green and purple (shows
as a virindi mask in buff bar)).
 Always try to USE the portals instead of running them. Often the portal
drops you down, when running it, you fall forward and miss the portal
below.
 1. Yellow Buff 
Run left, take left road and jump of the ramp. You'll notice 4 levels
with 5x5 platforms. As you look closely you'll see some platforms have
striping running east-west, others have striping north-south. The E-W
ones are solid, you can jump on these. Work your way to the portals
that get you up one level. After going trough the top portal, you'll
end up on a solid rock, go trough the orange portal and get portalled
to a new solid rock with a yellow portal. (=gives yellow buff).
 Maze Maps
by Trystan of Abendgrau
Level 1
Level 2
Level 3
Level 4
 2. Blue Buff 
Run left, take right road. Jump to the platform below to get your
portal/buff.
 3. Red Buff 
Run right, take right road. You'll see several platform above each
other with a green/red portal. Just randomly use portals untill you get
to a platform without barrier (2x green, 3x red did it for me, but I
heard other combos aswell). Jump to the platform below to get your
portal/buff.
 4. Green Buff 
Run right, take left road. I suggest you look at the setup first, you
should see 4 blue portals next to each other. A bit above the one on
the left is a 5th portal, a bit lighter in color. That's the portal you
need to get the green buff.
 In front of you is another portal. If you use this portal (don't run
it!), you fall down to the right portal. Each time you fall in a
portal, you drop again towards the next one. Try to select that 5th
portal (on the radar is easiest) and when falling down the 4th time,
click "USE" (F-key) as much as you can so you use the portal when
falling next to it.
 When you have these 4 buffs you need to get the purple buff (virindi
mask). Use the portal at the start of the maze. You should fall
down right in the purple portal (and pass other colors), if you're not
automatically portalled, use the purple portal.
 When you get back to the very start of the portalspace (the space with
the 'DO NOT ENTER' portal) you run straight ahead (south) untill you
come to yet another portal (not the DO NOT ENTER portal :)). Use it and
get portaled in the low-gravity area.
 Few things to remember :
 1) all platforms are solid
 2) platforms with red virindi monitors on them are off-limits
 3) you may kill virindi neogates
 4) when jumping to an adjacent platform, walk back to the far end of
the platform (so furthest from the target platform) and jump. Be
carefull of the yellow virindi, the rocket to/from platforms and might
throw you off jumping course.
 5) jumping diagonally = safer
 Work you're way trough to the solid rock with portal (don't forget in
all your excitement to take a few steps back when jumping to that solid
rock... lots jumped over it, very frustrating :))
 When using the portal, you end up at Thromer. Talk to him to finish.

quests._walk:
During the daytime, swim to the island. Here you will find six outer pillars and one inner pillar. You must determine the correct sequence to open the portal to the Temple. The best way to do this is one at a time, by touching an outer pillar then checking the inner pillar. The inner pillar will tell you how many of the six have been "set", so the key is to look for a change in description when clicking the center. If there is no change in description, try another pillar and then touch the center again. Do not touch a pillar that has been "set" already. Repeat this process until all six pillars have been "set" and a portal to the Temple will open.
- Once inside the dungeon, go to the area where the pathways go straight, back, upward, and downward
- Take the path to the very bottom
- Once you reach the bottom head straight EAST until you come to a big open room with two doorways in the back
- Both lead to one doorway, where you go inside and retrieve the Dark Lattice. Each person in the group should get a lattice
- Hand the Dark Lattice to the Well of Energy at an earlier point in the dungeon
- Speak to the quest starter to complete the quest
 Dungeon Map 
(Courtesy of Aria-Ii, Krysta and Ragefatha of Dawnsong)

This is a list of known melds. To meld cards, use the Tarot recipes under your Quest crafting recipe list.
 TWO-CARD MELDS 
 Twin Moons = The Living Moon + 
 The Shattered Moon
 Gateway: Apprentice = The 
Crafter x2
 THREE-CARD MELDS 
 Three Kingdoms = The Imperator + 
 The Lord of Light + The Shadow
 Three Paths = The Crafter + The Seeker + The Warrior
 Three Powers = The Eternal + 
 The Great Tree + The 
Indwelling
 Gateway: Journeyman = The 
Crafter x3
 FIVE-CARD MELDS 
 Gateway: Seeker in Light = The 
Great Tree + The Seeker + The Living Moon + The Lord of Light + The Imperator
 Gateway: Seeker in Darkness = The Indwelling + The Seeker + The Shadow + The Eternal + The Shattered Moon
 Gateway: Order and Chaos = The 
Eternal + The Shattered Moon + The Living Moon + The Imperator + The Indwelling
 Gateway: Master = The Crafter 
x5
 TWELVE-CARD MELDS 
 Deck of Power = One of each Greater Tarot
 Gateway: Grandmaster = The 
Crafter x12
 REWARDS 
The following rewards are gained by using your Significator card on a Meld. The Meld is consumed in this process, and each reward can only be gained once 
per character. It is unknown what effect, if any, your significator has on the reward. The rewards scale to at least level 74, and likely higher
 Significator + Twin Moons = 1% 
percentage XP award
 Significator + Three Kingdoms = 
1.5% percentage XP award
 Significator + Three Paths = 
1.5% percentage XP award
 Significator + Three Powers = 
1.5% percentage XP award
 Significator + Gateway: Seeker 
in Light = 3% percentage XP award
 Significator + Gateway: Seeker 
in Darkness = 3% percentage XP award
 Significator + Gateway: Order 
and Chaos = 3% percentage XP award
 Significator + Deck of Power = 
7% percentage XP award
 Significator + Gateway: 
Apprentice = 2000 CXP
 Significator + Gateway: 
Journeyman = 3000 CXP
 Significator + Gateway: Master 
= 4000 CXP
 Significator + Gateway: 
Grandmaster = 6938 CXP
 FATE CARDS

quests.title: Dereth Tarot

quests._walk:
The Dark Agent instructs you to steal three artifacts, one from each kingdom's domain. The quest is solo propagated, meaning each member of a fellowship must get the three items to advance the quest. It is recommended to use the nearby lifestone, as you will have to recall back to the Dark Agent several times.
She first hands you a key which you can use to enter the Order kingdom's Scriptorium and steal the Scroll of the Deeping Well. Using the key will transport you to the Scriptorium, and the key appears to have unlimited uses. This small dungeon is relatively straightforward, and you must proceed through several rooms of Scriptorium Guards. (level 50 solo monsters) The Scroll is at the top of a platform in the last room. Pick it up to advance the quest, and then hand the Scroll to the Dark Agent.
Next, the Dark Agent instructs you to steal the Lens of Perception from Virindi Portalspace. You can enter Portalspace by talking to a Virindi Adumbrator at any continent nexus. Speak to the Virindi Monitor Welcomer at the start to gain entry to the Virindi museum. This room is a small maze of walkways, with the Lens of Perception found at the top. Several Virindi Caretakers (level 50 solo monsters) will attack you on the way, though ranged classes can take them out from a distance quite easily. Bring the Lens back to the Dark Agent to advance the quest.
Finally, the Dark Agent will ask you to convince Naokim to gain entry to the Shadow vaults, so that you can steal the Codex of Shadows. Speak to Naokim in the Shadow Antechamber (near the Forge in Ikeras) several times to enter. Be prepared to fight several level 50 Shadow Protectors (solo monster) In the shadow tunnels, take your first right, and then a left until you enter a wide open area with three doors. There is a series of levers and doors which lead to several Shadow Vault Chests and the Codex of Shadows. The Codex of Shadows is located near the level 55 "boss" shadow (solo monster) Be sure to open as many Vault Chests as you can, as they often contain huge gems and magical loot, and you can never return here once completing the quest. You can only open around 12 Vault Chests per character. Once you steal the Codex, hand it to the Dark Agent to complete the Path of Darkness quest.

quests.title: Path of Darkness

quests._walk:
Lataua will give you a necklace and present you with a choice: Either give the necklace to the Dark Agent and forever choose the "darkness" path, or speak to the Dark Agent and then return to Lataua to stay on the "light" path. If you choose the darkness path, it's a permanent choice and you cannot complete the Path of Light or Retracing the Path quests ever again.
Assuming you chose the light path, Lataua will tell you to use the necklace for guidance. Using the necklace brings you visions of the Order kingdom's Scriptorium. Speak to the Hand of Asheron in Ikeras (near the refinery) to enter the Scriptorium. Here you will encounter Renegade Swordsmen (level 50 humans) fighting Scriptorium Guards and Scribes. Only the Renegades will attack you on sight; beware their stun attacks. Continue through this straightforward dungeon until you encounter a Renegade Leader (level 55) on a platform. Defeat the leader to advance the quest, then return to Lataua
Lataua will tell you to once again use your necklace for guidance. It shows you your next goal, Virindi Portalspace. Enter the Virindi museum as you did in the Path of Darkness quest. This time, your goal is to defeat the Renegade Mages (level 50) and the Renegade Archmage (level 55) at the top. Defeating the Archmage advances the quest.
Return to Lataua once again to advance the quest, then use your necklace again. You must enter the Shadow Vault and protect the Codex from the renegades there. Speak to Naokim (in the Shadow Antechamber in Ikeras) until he allows you entry to the Vault. Once inside, defeat several Renegade Archers (level 50) and work your way down to the levers area of the dungeon. Beware of archers shooting through walls and doors here. The Renegade Captain (level 55) is your target, and he is located in the center doorway area. Defeat him and then return to Lataua to complete the quest, and remove your Chaos Corruption!

quests._desc: There are 2 quests inside Aun Tanua's Fortress: "Kill Kogun" and "Stop Aun Tanaua". Speak with Emperor Thoromer, Nalica, or Naokim to get the quests and a glyph used to enter the fortress portal.
quests._walk:
Once you have gathered these you must use the Fanatic Armor Fragment, Fanatic Armor Scrap, Tattered Fanatic Armor Plate on the Shredded Fanatic Armor Plate to create a Fanatic Disguise .
 Now that you have the disguise you can enter Aun Tanua's fortress portal at 8.3S 43.2E. Once there you need to cross an invisible bridge. On the other side is an orb, give glyph to orb and use it to go in. You can now use orb anytime, even if you die and need to come back.
Check out this animated gif that shows the bridge:
Invisible Bridge to the Fortress (573kb) 
Once inside head down the passage, until you reach some fanatics, then turn left, do not venture to the right, or wisps will spawn on you. You will find yourself in room with 3 portals and an open hole, where you can see an acid pit with acid spurts. Use the South portal, to portal up one level, then use the portal that will be on your left, so it would end up being, form the bottom, S-E-N-W-S-E. You will the find yourself in what is like a maze.
 Turn out of the passage so you are facing S. The trick is to avoid all red passages, levers and gates, while moving left whenever you can. Head down the S passage, and take the 2nd left. Follow this passage and take the right at the end of the passage. From here, you should be facing S and a gate at the same time, turn left here, and take your first right, then turn left at the end. Head to the end of the passage, and turn right twice, then left twice, then follow the passage to the end, turning right, you will reach 3 gates, and a field of portals behind them.
 Of all the levers, there is only one that DOES NOT SPAWN Wisps. To get to this lever you need to take all rights as you enter, unless you can go left, a map will be available soon.
 Pass the gates into the field of portals, the blue portals will just portal you above and make you fall down. There is a portal, which is teal, and is found in the bottom right hand corner of the room, on the nearest row, 2nd from the wall. Use this portal.
 The portal will drop you in another passage, follow it straight down, and you will reach a room with a wall in front of you. Behind this wall are fanatic rangers, sages, juggernauts and zealots, as well as the boss, Kogun. Here your disguise will not work, and you must defeat Kogun.
 Kogun is a former captain in the Order of Dereth. A well-known juggernaut hero, he is now Aun Tanuaâ's chief lieutenant and trusted aid. He is level 75 Juggernaut, with 90,000 health and vigor.
Defeat him to complete the Kill Kogun quest.
 Now with Kogun defeated head into the second room were Aun Tanua is waiting. Hand him the items in correct order (Listed above).
 Note: Make sure everyone in fellowship has an Order Doctrine to hand in to complete their quest. For the other items only 1 person in the fellowship needs to hand in.
Once you have completed the quest you get to see a little movie.

quests.title: Kingdom Fort Raid

quests._walk:
Start at Chaos Obelisk (54.1N 9.3W) north of Chaos Plane. The easiest way to get here is through the chaos portals, like in the crater, or on the island near Zu. Eventually the portals will bring you to the "warzone" area full of low-mid 60's level undead.
Examine the Chaos Obelisk. It will show all eight defense nexi and which kingdom controls each. It will also show which kingdom last controlled the Abyssal Core. There are 4 defense nexi each for the Filinuvekta and Archon sides. The idea is to open the Abyssal Core Portal in front of the Chaos Obelisk. To do this, you must change least one full side of Defense Nexi to your kingdom.
 Defense Nexus Locations 
 Filinuvekta 
Final (52.3N 9.7W)
Primary (55.5N 9.5W)
Secondary (52.5N 8.3W)
Triary (53.9N 10.8W)
 Archons 
Final (57.5N 3.7W)
Primary (57.4N 8.5W)
Secondary (54.1N 6.1W)
Triary (57.3N 6.1W) 
Once at a Defense Nexus, enter the portal. At the center of each dungeon is a Tortured Revenant. (group-statted) Kill him to change that nexus' kingdom to yours. Do the same for all others on one side, and an Abyssal Core Portal (restricted to your kingdom only; opens for 2 hours) appears in front of the Chaos Obelisk. This portal will not open if the core was last controlled by your kingdom.
There are 4 quarters inside the Abyssal Core dungeon:
- Power Quarter
- Transport Quarter
- Imbue Quarter
- Defense Quarter
Each Quarter has a golem guard and portal behind it. Kill the golem guard to enter the portal, and kill the boss Revenant inside to receive a Crystal. The crystal is automatically given to the player who dealt the most damage.
Now, go to your kingdom HQ in Ikeras, and talk to the Engineer to recieve your xp award.
Hand in the the crystal(s) received from the boss(es) to upgrade your Guiding Mechanism in your kingdom fort. (Arramora)

DELVING
One of the uses of lodestones is to create delving stones. The recipe to craft these stones is located under mining skills, and there is one recipe for each type of stone/material. Simply place the lodestone into the Delving Stone recipe and craft. There is no chance of failure. A delving stone can be used to "summon" trait mines in front of the user. This mine can only be used by the person who discovered it. The mines allow three "chops" each, but they provide a bonus of approximately 20 trait per swing.

HARMONICS
Another use for the lodestones is to create harmonic stones. The stone is used to imbue a weapon with a damage bonus vs. a specific type of monster. The recipe to create these Harmonic Stones is located under spellbinding. There are five levels of imbuing stones, and each is limited to a maximum character level (*not* weapon level) The only other component is 10k-50k coal, depending on the level of stone. The type of bonus is based on the type of lodestone used, as shown below:
 + Clouded Lodestone = Arcane Harmonic Stone (bonus vs. magical or energy-based creatures) 
 + Marble Lodestone = Martial Harmonic Stone (bonus vs. weapon-wielding creatures) 
 + Mossy Lodestone = Mossy Harmonic Stone (bonus vs. plant and animal creatures) 
 + Rusty Lodestone = Harmonic Stone of Decay (bonus vs. undead, olthoi, evil creatures) 
 + Translucent Lodestone = Neutral Imbuing Stone (bonus vs. all creatures) 
When an item is crafted, you will see "This item can become harmonic." This means that a harmonic stone can be applied to it. Once this happens, another stone cannot be applied. The weapon will show an enchantment such as "Harmonics of Decay," as shown here . After use against that type of monster, the damage bonus will grow and be displayed on the weapon. This bonus will grow to a maximum of 20% for Translucent stones (since they affect all monster types) and 40% for all others. Do not be alarmed if the bonus does not appear right away, as it does take some time to begin honing.
LODESTONE DEVICES
Lodestones can also be used to create devices for the "Sigil of Unity" quest. Simply speak to the NPC's near the Knorr Portal (18.7N 26.0E). Each NPC serves a different level range, and will ask you to create a "Sigil of Unity". The type (shining, smooth, rough, etc.) is dependent on your level and tells you what quality of lodestone you will need to have made into a device.
Under some crafting skills, you will see a category for Lodestone Devices. There are four different types of devices: skull, sword, drum, and scepter. Each one is created by an armorsmith, martial weaponsmith, exotic weaponsmith, and toolmaker. They require crafting skill to create, they can fail, but they give cxp. The lodestone and a small amount of deruwood, obsidian, or flawless pyreal are required, and consumed upon crafting.
Once all four parts are acquired, open the Sigil of Unity recipe under your Quest Recipe panel, and craft the Sigil. This craft cannot fail and requires no other craft skill once the devices have already been made. Hand this device to complete the quest and gain a small (less than 1%) reward.

quests.title: Piercing the Shield wall

quests._walk:
Make sure you talk to all NPC's until they stop advancing the quest for you. Once thats done head to the Olthoi Tunnels 56.6S 34.6E If you can not get in you didnt advance fully from the NPC's at the Shield gate.
 Once inside the olthoi tunnels you need to do a few things
 Find the shaper room and talk to the shaper inside to advance
 Find a runic cube
 Properly inscribe the runic cube and hand it in.
 Find a blank Mnemonic cube and hand it in to become a Ciphered Mnemonic Cube.
 1) When you walk in and head down the 3 rooms you need to work with are in a Fork position. Shapers room was straight ahead. Once you find it you will need to go in(no key required) and advance off the npc inside. He will ask you to find a Runic cube and properly inscribe it.
 2) You need to head to the store room now. Store room was on the North end and the map room was on the South, Entrance to the store room requires each player to have a key. The keys for the store room can be found off the various Gearknight Legionary corpses laying around the Olthoi Tunnels. Once in the Store room, each person needs to take a Runic cube off the ground to be inscribed. 
 3) Now you need to head to the map room. Entrance to the map room requires each player to have a key as well. They are also found on the Gearknight corpses. Once in the map room you will need to inscribe your Runic cube. The correct inscription is Block, block, block, dot, dot, dot, block, dot. To do this each person has to pick up a stylus from either table from the sides of the room.
 Use the stylus on the block well. Your stylus becomes a Block stylus in your inventory. Use the block stylus on the Runic cube. The block stylus now reverts back to a regular stylus.
 Again, Use the stylus on the block well. Your stylus becomes a Block stylus in your inventory. Use the block stylus on the Runic cube. The block stylus now reverts back to a regular stylus.
 A 3rd time, -Use the stylus on the block well. Your stylus becomes a Block stylus in your inventory. Use the block stylus on the Runic cube. The block stylus now reverts back to a regular stylus.
 Now use the Stylus on the Dot well. Your stylus becomes a Dot stylus in your inventory. Use the dot stylus on the runic cube. The dot stylus now reverts back to a regular stylus.
 Again, use the Stylus on the Dot well. Your stylus becomes a Dot stylus in your inventory. Use the dot stylus on the runic cube. The dot stylus now reverts back to a regular stylus.
 A 3rd time, use the Stylus on the Dot well. Your stylus becomes a Dot stylus in your inventory. Use the dot stylus on the runic cube. The dot stylus now reverts back to a regular stylus.
 One more time, use the stylus on the block well. Your stylus becomes a Block stylus in your inventory. Use the block stylus on the Runic cube. The block stylus now reverts back to a regular stylus.
 And lastly, use the Stylus on the Dot well. Your stylus becomes a Dot stylus in your inventory. Use the dot stylus on the runic cube. The dot stylus now reverts back to a regular stylus.
 Note: You will not hear any "quest advances" during this process.
 To verify you did the painting correctly double click the cube in your pack. It should look like ::. With the correct cube, head to the shapers room again and hand in your Runic Cube. 
 4) You will get a quest advance saying in order for him to make a ciphered mnemonic cube he needs a plain one first. The mnemonic cube is located in the Storeroom(same as runic) in the back left part. Each person needs their own Mnemonic cube. Take it back to the Shapers room and turn into the npc. He will hand you back the Ciphered Mnemonic Cube that you need to gain access to the shield wall door. Use the Ciphered Mnemonic Cube on the door like a key. You now can use the door to get across without having to go through the dungeon in Part 1.

quests.title: Trace the Bounds

quests._walk:
Malatwa wants you to investigate the Olthoi Mound around 51S 31E. Make your way to the Olthoi Mound cave at 50.3S 31.1E. Head inside and be careful, because some olthoi are at the portal destination. Once inside, use the support pillar to advance the quest.
Now you must return to Malatwa. She sends you to talk to Gear Master (inside fort also, but down stairs). He says you need to search for a gear that works near the Shield Wall to open a door to the Gearknight dungeon.
Go to Gearknight dungeon at 52.6S 32.2E (use gear to go in) Don't attack the Gearknights until you arrive to a cross section with 3 Gearknights in right passage and none at left. Take a left down stairs and talk to Captain to advance.
Then, go back to Gear Master. Quest advances and he ask for you to get a Baton 3L.
Enter the Armory in the door to the left of the Gear Master. Inside, go to the front hall, then to a room at the northeast. Kill the 3 Gearknights inside and loot a key. Go to the locked north door and enter using key (Only need 1 key per group). Inside in the left room you can pick up the BATON 3L, you only need one per fellow. 
Go back to the Gear Master and give the baton (everyone must be close to advance). 
Now go back to the Olthoi Mound dungeon and use baton on the Support Pillar to get the information in it (use it like a key in the Pillar). 
Head back to the Gearknight dungeon and speak with the Captain again. He will summon a portal to the Olthoi Mound. 
Now, the tricky part: The Gearknights must destroy the pillar, and your fellow needs to clean out the Olthoi in order for them to do the job. Swarms of olthoi will keep spawing and they hit hard, attacking both players and gearknights. If anyone, dies they can re-enter the Olthoi Mound through the standard entrance.
IMPORTANT NOTE: If Pillar is destroyed and you are not inside you will not be able to finish the quest! 
When the Gearknight destroys the pillar, you will advance and see the "LEGION OF DOOM" movie. Return to Malatwa to finish the quest.

quests.title: Legion of Doom

quests._desc: Excavate and assemble a treasure map from the remote corners of the Ramparts!
quests._walk:
She sells you excavation tools for digging at the "excavation points" located in the Ramparts area. Buy at least a dozen of these, as you will need several of them to complete the quest, and obtain loot.
 First, Elpeth sends you to an excavation point to collect Fragment #1 (of 6). You can return to her, then, to advance the quest. You then have to locate the excavation points for the other 5 pieces. Some of these points have difficult guardians which must be avoided or fought to excavate. 
 Other excavation points contain loot, and seem to have a use timer. The loot is better than average, and often contains a lot of magical items.
 Fragment #1 at 39.0S 25.2E - Only 2 group mobs - Mezz or lure away from the excavation point
 Fragment #2 at 42.4S 44.9E - Tricky to get there, but can be done under lifestone protection. Go from the south end of hill. Avoid or battle the iron colossi. The excavation point is inside the fort.
 Fragment #3 at 47.9S 39.8E - North of Fort Strathelar. Only solo monsters.
 Fragment #4 at 42.4S 32.9E - Only solo monsters.
 Fragment #5 at 45.6S 30.6E - Hardest. This area is beautiful but deadly. In in the middle of the city over water, there is an Ebon Queen wasp. It has strong missile and AoE ice attacks. Take caution navigating the bridge tunnels here, it's easy to get trapped or sniped from other directions.
 Fragment #6 at 51.5S 32.5E - Takeru camp, west of Forrt Strathelar. Mostly solo Takeru, usually one Laes Takeru nearby. Kill or draw away to excavate.
Go back to Aerie and give piece #1 to Elpeth, if you haven't already. She gives it back and you get a recipe to craft the map with all 6 pieces. Craft the map to advance the quest.
 Head to the Ancestor Head at 42.3S 38.4E, and give it the completed map to enter a dungeon. Once inside, take lefts until you get to a misty room with two other exits. Go right to get a key. Now, go back to the room and go left to the locked door.
 Past the door, you must kill the boss (lvl 75, solo). Beware the stun attacks and critical hits, especially if you attempt this alone. 
 Once you have defeated the boss, loot the key which opens the hoard chest. NOTE: Everyone in the group must get and use a key to advance the quest. The loot you find in the chest is a bonus. Return to Elpeth Arden in Aerie to complete the quest.

quests._desc: A Falatacot sorceror enlists your help gaining access to crypt under the estate.
quests._walk:
After you get the quest go to the location marked on the map, and enter the Realaidain Estate through the front door. Talk to Aldemon once inside, continue talking until you no longer get quest advances.
 Go through the northern door, in the room one of the bookcases is selectable. 
Use the bookcase to go into the hidden room, and speak with Mallenos once inside. 
He gives a sub-quest called Trace The Bounds. You must complete this quest before you are able to complete Crypt Keys.
 Return to Aldemon and speak with him once Trace the Bounds is complete. He gives you a Crypt Key, and your quest advances.
Give the Crypt Key to Zroth (58.0S, 57.8E) to advance the quest.
Return to Aldemon (inside the mansion) and let him know what has happened with Zroth and the key, to complete the Crypt Keys quest.

quests.title: Crypt Keys

quests._walk:
You must go forth and gather seeds which may be found in underground tunnels on an island west of the Skyport. Go to the Underground Tunnels (Biggest Landmass, West of Caerlin Skyport @ 29.6S, 25.8E)
Inside, keep going down until you find a big room with Seed Storage Caches. Open the Seed Storage and loot a Quatrid Seed Packet. This will advance your quest.
Now that you've obtained a seed packet, youll need to plant your seeds in some rich soil. Recall back to Caerlin Skyport.
Click the Quatrid Seed Packet and follow the instructions in your chat box. It will guide you to a rich soil area on the southeast beach where you can use the packet. Once you plant the seeds, the quest will advance.
Now you must protect the plants from hungry creatures until they mature. When it matures, examine the plant and harvest some Quatrid Wheat. This will advance your quest.
The grain you harvested now needs to be ground into flour and baked. Fortunately, there happens to be a baker in this region. Hand the Quatrid Grain Sheaf to Tretna Byer (Yaosenji, Windmill top of the hill @ 36.1S, 36.7E). She will bake a nice Aluvian Flat Bread for you. This will advance your quest.
If you have more grain to turn in to the baker, you should do so now. Otherwise, bring the food supplies to the Supplymaster on the Skyport. Hand Aluvian Flat Bread to Torgara (Caerlin Skyport @ 30.5S, 34.2E) to complete the quest.

quests._desc: Find and decode the Passkey to gain access to the Foundry
quests._walk:
You can now enter several buildings in Vothardun. They tend to open in order, so it's recommended to do them in the order shown below.
 Library - Read the Lost Letter Pages inside (lore). Look for a trapdoor on the floor and use it. Work your way down to find Black Bone, a giant skeleton. Kill it, and loot the Atlan's Foundry Guide (lore). Exit Library.
 Armory - Another trapdoor. Go down, and through a small dungeon. Kill the Master At Arms, loot the Passkey, and exit the Armory
 Tower Barracks - Work your way to the top of the tower using the ladders. The skeletons at the top have a Tower Basement Key. One key is needed per person. Jump down to the bottom, use the key on the locked trapdoor in the center of the room. Proceed down the dungeon until you get to Elish The Rank. Kill it and loot the Glyph Daroa, then take the portal to the surface.
 Magister's House - Another trapdoor dungeon. Work your way down to Magister Govik, kill him, and loot a Glyph Eltau. Beware the fast respawn behind you, if you decide to kill all the liches here. Exit the Magister's House.
 House of Omikesh - Work your way down through another small trapdoor dungeon and kill Lord Omikesh. Loot the final Glyph, and exit to Vothardun.
 Foundry Gates - Head back to the Foundry Gates. Place the glyphs in the Passkey. They only work in a certain order, but you can't make a mistake since it won't let you place the wrong one. Use the completed Passkey on the Foundry Gates to complete the quest.

quests._desc: Find and eliminate four powerful generals in Aerfalle's undead army.
quests._walk:
Killing Lord Relos starts this quest, but to complete the quest series you will want to first enter the following buildings, in this order:
 Tinker's Workshop - Trapdoor dungeon, kill Master Tinker. Loot the Mysterious Device (used in Refinery quest) and then exit the workshop.
 Inquisitor's House - Kill Fymras the Inquisitor in the trapdoor dungeon and loot a Damaged Golem Heart. You should see a small vignette and receive the Heart of Stone quest. Exit the house.
 Meeting Hall - Work your way down to kill Lord Relos, and loot the Troop Status report to actually receive the Aerfalle's Generals quest.
 Officer's Quarters - Trapdoor dungeon, kill Marshal Aquilis. Loot his Burial Grounds Report
 Kill Aerfalle's Generals - When you loot the Troop Status, you get the locations of Aerfalle's four generals in your quest panel. They are group undead ranging from level 56-62, and can be killed in any order. Each one has a key.
 Atlan Gates - Head back to the Foundry Gates east of Vothardun. Inside, you will see the Atlan Gates, which lead to the actual foundry complex. Hand the four keys to the gate to gain access to the Foundry, and complete the quest.

quests._desc: Recreate one of the ancient Foundry Golems to make Atlan's Forge burn once more.
quests._walk:
Pyreal Mines - Gather at least 9 pieces of Blue Pyreal Ore from the Pyreal Mines (29.2S, 58.8E, marked on map). There are solo and group undead in here, but the group undead do not need to be killed to advance. The Ore is found on the ground sparkling in various parts of the Mines. You will need 8 pieces of Ore to make a bar, and one to advance the quest. Use the Damaged Golem Heart with a piece of Blue Pyreal Ore to create a Golem Heart and advance the quest.
 Atlan's Foundry, Factory - Enter Atlan's Foundry and look for a Factory door just inside. This is the only door you can enter at this time. Kill the Foundry Protector golem, and then enter the Control Room. You will also get the Factory quest at this time.
 Atlan's Foundry, Mana Battery - In the center of the room, you will see four golems guarding a gear. To get through here, you will need to use your golem heart to create a golem and destroy it. Head to the right, and you will see a Mana Battery. Give the heart to the battery to obtain a Charged Golem Heart. 
 Atlan's Foundry, Black Slab - Now, head back to the room with the four golems, this time going straight into the tunnel across the room. (It would be on the left, if you were just entering) When you get to the Black Slab in the middle of the magma, give the Charged Golem Heart to it. You will get an Imprinted Golem Heart which can be used three times to summon a golem. (NOTE: Do not give anything else to the battery, as it can deal major damage) (NOTE: Do not interact with the Black Slab in any other way, or it will spawn Unstable Magma Golems...and they are very unstable)
 Atlan's Foundry, Control Room - With your Charged Golem Heart, head back to the room with the golems. Dispatch the golems, and use your Heart to summon a pet magma golem. This golem will attack the gear in the center of the room. While it does this, you must kill the surrounding hostile golems as they appear, so that your magma golem can concentrate on its work. Eventually, fires will be redirected to the Forge, and a new door to the Foreman's Office will open. This will complete the "Heart of Stone" quest.

quests._desc: Use the ancient Foundry to create a blue pyreal bar
quests._walk:
Atlan's Foundry, Vent Shaft - After you kill the Foreman, you can proceed to the Vent Shaft. A Vent Shaft Guard golem (55, group) will portal itself around the room at random. Kill it to loot a Glowing Gem that can be used to portal you randomly to different platforms in the area. Eventually you will be right next to the Refining Maintenance door, which you should enter.
 Atlan's Foundry, Refinery - The first thing you will see is a maintenance golem. Talk to it to get a quest to kill 10 Magma Golems in the Sluice.
 Atlan's Foundry, Sluice - Simply kill 10 Magma Golems, then run through (or back) the doors until you get back to the Maintenance Golem. 
 Atlan's Foundry, Refinery - Speak to the Golem for access to the Refinery Chief's Workshop. Kill the Chief (65, group) inside and loot its medallion. Give this medallion to the Refinery Golem. Note: Do not hand the medallion to the maintenance golem as he will keep it.
The golem will now take Blue Pyreal Ore (you did collect some, right?) and convert it to Blue Pyreal Motes. Once you've gotten eight motes from the golem, you get a subquest called "Pyreal Mines" and a recipe to combine them into a Pyreal Bar. Create the bar. 
Remember that "Mysterious Device" you found under the Tinker's Workshop in Vothardun? Use it on the Smith's Chambers door to enter, and complete the Refinery quest.

quests._walk:
Atlan's Foundry, Smith's Chambers - First, you must find a blank Atlan Emblem. They are relatively common among the undead in the area. Use the emblem on a weapon in your inventory to "imprint" the weapon type on it. This will be the type of Atlan weapon you want to create. 
Eventually, you will come to the Smith himself (65, group). Prepare for the hardest and final battle of this quest. He uses magic attacks, notably Icy Cloud, an area-of-effect spell. Killing him will complete the Smith's Chambers quest. His corpse will have three attuned Tesserae and a book of Atlan's Weapon Recipes. Killing him will also grant you access to the Forge directly from the entryway of Atlan's Foundry.

quests._desc: Long-lost recipes and procedures have allowed you to craft your own Atlan Weapon!
quests._walk:
Once you have the book of recipes and access to the Forge, you can create your Atlan Weapon at any time. They work like normal craft recipes, except you can't fail, and you have to be at Atlan's Forge. The level (arcane lore) of the item can be scaled from item level 45-85 with the arrows on the recipe, and damage is comparable to non-weighted crafted weapons. 
Recipe examples:
 Atlan Sword L45 - Pyreal Bar, Atlan Sword Emblem, 40000 Coal, 2057 Iron, 299 Steel, 1639 Hide, 24 Flawless Pyreal
Atlan Sword L85 - Pyreal Bar, Atlan Sword Emblem, 40000 Coal, 3432 Iron, 1716 Steel, 4249 Hide, 2456 Flawless Pyreal 
Once you create your first weapon, you get recipes to imbue it with harmonics, as well. These harmonic imbues add +20% damage against a certain type of monster, but never grow. They consume a lodestone, and are temporary. There is also a Focus Imbue, effect unknown at this time.
(NOTE: Beware when crafting at the forge. Undead often portal in and attack unsuspecting adventurers)

quests._desc: A mad dash to mine as much trait as possible in five minutes from the Shaper's Hoard!
quests._walk:
Each key will open a certain Shaper's Hoard according to the key name, found at these locations:
 Osteth 
 Iron - 25.0N 29.6E (South of NE Drudge Citadel outpost)
 Crystal - 38.0N 5.5W (South of Arwic)
 Wood - 40.5N, 19.5W (Near Millstone)
 Stone - 18.5N 9.5W (Molwirth, near Mist Opal Boots dungeon)
 Silver - 2.6N, 13.8E (Prosper ringway, Slavetaker area)
 Omishan 
 Wood - 5,7N, 64,3 E (Near the Rally Quest Starter) 
 Stone - 15.0N, 88.3E (Hakata, 1st ringway) 
 Silver - 34.4N, 87,7E (Ankoro, 2nd ringway) 
 Crystal - 6.1N, 38.3E (Mayoi, 1st ringway) 
 Iron - 29.2N, 50.8E (Rakani, west of great tree) 
 Linvak 
 Crystal - 16.6S 10.8W (Old Stone Mine) 
 Iron - 26.5S 29.0W (Stoneshadow southwest)
 Silver - 13.2S 41.3W (Old Acid Still) 
 Wood - 9.8S 17.3W (Thusik ringway) 
 Stone - 2.2S 31.6W (Winterhollows)
When you use one of these keys, everyone in the fellowship gets a 10-minute quest to enter the hoard. Each person must use the hoard, and is then portalled inside. Inside the hoard, you will see "mines" which can be extracted from three times before they vanish. You get five minutes to run around and extract all you can before getting automatically portalled out. Mines are in static spots, and respawn approximately every two minutes. Also, upon entering the mine, you will lose all run buffs and will have to reapply or re-equip any run buff/items when you leave.
Solo, you just run around and mine for ten minutes. However, if you have a group, you don't want to go in all at once, or there won't be enough mines to go around. There is an optimal way for a fellowship of nine people to mine, though, without bumping into each other.
- First, designate three groups and one direction each (left, right, center)
- Once the 10 minute quest timer starts, the three people in Group 1 enter the mine, each going right, left, or center.
- When there is approximately 5:15 left on the quest timer, Group 2 enters in the same fashion. Group 1 will be getting portalled out around this time.
- When there is approximately 0:15 left on the quest timer, Group 3 enters in the same fashion. Group 2 will be getting portalled out around this time.
- This is how you use the 10 minute timer to get nine people through. 
Some tips for mining while inside: If you take the left or right path, you should have enough time to mine the hallways, mine the big rooms, and then return to the hallways to do it twice within the 5-minute timer. You can also do the same with the center path. Another tactic for the center path, though, is to not mine the big room when you get to it. Instead, take the other exit out of this room and travel up one level in the dungeon. This will give you access to the mines on the second level. Mine these and then jump down into the big room to harvest some more!

quests.title: Aldemon's Slaughterfest

quests._desc: Explore the haunted crypts under Asheron's Estate and test your wits against the Chroma Puzzles!
quests._walk:
First, enter the crypts at Realaidain Estate simply by clicking the entrance. Aldemon will only grant access to those who have completed the above quests and slain Zroth
Throughout the crypt, you will find Crypt Chests. They contain loot, and more importantly, Chroma Spheres. While exploring the dungeon, be sure to keep one of each sphere: Yellow, Green, Cyan, Red, Magenta, and Blue. You will need these for the final room of the crypt. Also, beware of "trap" spawns. When you pick up a key, open a chest, or sometimes just walk into a room, Sepulchral and Greater Sepulchral Bones skeletons (55-60, solo) will spawn around you. Make sure you are healed up before opening any chests, as their armor-piercing special attacks can hurt in groups, even at high level.
 Eastern Crypts 
There are three sections in the main crypt. The first thing you will want to do is grab the Brass Crypt Key in the east section (where you first enter). Take your first left, continue through this hallway, and you will see the key in one of the side rooms on the left.
Head in a westward direction and you will see a large room, with several skeletons, chests, and a Gold Crypt Key. I did not find a use for this key, and it is not required to complete the quest. There are two exits down from this room, which I'll refer to as the north and south crypt areas.
 Southern Crypts 
Head to the south crypts. The southeast hall in this area will lead to a locked door (use Brass Key). The Silver Key spawns here. 
Go to the NW hallway of the south crypts. You will arrive at a locked portcullis, and a Crypt Guardian. The Silver Key will open this, or the Guardian will sometimes open it. The Iron Key is inside on the ground.
Once you have the Iron Key in hand, head back up into the large Gold Key room and into the north crypts.
 Northern Crypts 
In the north crypts, head all the way north to a locked door. The Iron Key opens this door and gives you the Bronze Key. By this time, you should have a full set of six Chroma Spheres. If not, collect them from the chests located throughout the crypt.
 Eastern Crypts 
Head back up to the large Gold Key room again, and into the east crypts where you started. Remember the locked door with the lever behind it? The Bronze Key opens that door.
Pull the lever, and run straight out of that room until you come to the door where you first entered the crypts. There, take a left, run down the hallway, and through the door at the end (which should now be open, thanks to the lever).
 Portcullis Maze 
This area is a small portcullis maze. Some gates you can open, and some you cannot. Mouse-clicking or cycling through items ("O" key, by default) are the best ways to find out which you can open. Beware the Vengeful Ghost, an invisible monster which will attack (and generally annoy you) as you progress through the maze. You cannot kill the ghost. Your goal is all the way to the north, where you will see a Chromatic Door. Enter it to get that pesky ghost off your back, and solve the puzzle inside.
 Chromatic Door 
Now, it's time for the real puzzle. The star in the room has six triangles at its points, each a different color, and a multicolored center. Handing Chroma Spheres to the individual points changes their color, and clicking on the center gives you hints. Handing a Chroma Sphere to the triangle does not consume the Sphere, so you only need one of each to solve all the puzzles here.
The idea is to turn the points to the correct color, then click them in the correct order. There are six different solutions, and each one will grant you XP and loot from a Realaidain Chest. After each solution, loot the chest and enter the "Back to Crypts" portal to return to the Chromatic Door. The triangles will revert to their original colors after a minute or two. Upon completing all six, simply enter the puzzle room again and click the center of the star to complete Asheron's Crypt and receive your reward.
 NOTE: Don't read any further if you'd like to solve the Chroma puzzles yourself! 
First, orient yourself so that the red triangle is at the top of your screen. For purposes of this guide, I'll number these colors, clockwise: Red 1, Green 2, Blue 3, Cyan 4, Magenta 5, Yellow 6. Hand the spheres of the appropriate color to the triangle as noted below, then click each triangle in the order shown. A "click" will mean it's set correctly, while a "clack" is an incorrect color.
 CHROMA KEY 1 SOLUTION 
1 Red - Yellow then Green
2 Green - Cyan then Blue
3 Blue - Cyan then Green
4 Cyan - Red
5 Magenta - Green
6 Yellow - Blue
Triangles should be all white, click in the order 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
 CHROMA KEY 2 SOLUTION 
1 Red - Cyan
2 Green - Magenta
3 Blue - Yellow
4 Cyan - Yellow then Magenta
5 Magenta - Cyan then Yellow
6 Yellow - Magenta then Cyan
Triangles should be all black, click in the order 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1
 CHROMA KEY 3 SOLUTION 
1 Red - Yellow then Green
2 Green - Magenta
3 Blue - Cyan then Green
4 Cyan - Yellow then Magenta
5 Magenta - Green
6 Yellow - Magenta then Cyan
Triangles should be W/B/W/B/W/B, click in the order 5, 1, 3, 6, 2, 4
 CHROMA KEY 4 SOLUTION 
1 Red - Cyan
2 Green - Cyan then Blue
3 Blue - Yellow
4 Cyan - Red
5 Magenta - Cyan then Yellow
6 Yellow - Blue
Triangles should be B/W/B/W/B/W, click in the order 6, 2, 4, 5, 1, 3
 CHROMA KEY 5 SOLUTION 
1 Red - Yellow then Green
2 Green - Cyan then Blue
3 Blue - Cyan then Green
4 Cyan - Magenta then Cyan then Yellow
5 Magenta - Yellow then Magenta then Cyan
6 Yellow - Magenta then Yellow then Cyan
Triangles should be W/W/W/R/G/B, click in the order 1, 4, 2, 5, 3, 6
 CHROMA KEY 6 SOLUTION 
1 Red - Green then Cyan then Yellow
2 Green - Cyan then Magenta then Yellow
3 Blue - Magenta then Yellow then Cyan
4 Cyan - Yellow then Magenta
5 Magenta - Cyan then Yellow
6 Yellow - Magenta then Cyan
Triangles should be C/M/Y/B/B/B, click in the order 4, 1, 5, 2, 6, 3

In the north crypts, head all the way north to a locked door. The Iron Key opens this door and gives you the Bronze Key. By this time, you should have a full set of six Chroma Spheres. If not, collect them from the chests located throughout the crypt.
 Eastern Crypts 
Head back up to the large Gold Key room again, and into the east crypts where you started. Remember the locked door with the lever behind it? The Bronze Key opens that door.
Pull the lever, and run straight out of that room until you come to the door where you first entered the crypts. There, take a left, run down the hallway, and through the door at the end (which should now be open, thanks to the lever).
 Portcullis Maze 
This area is a small portcullis maze. Some gates you can open, and some you cannot. Mouse-clicking or cycling through items (

key, by default) are the best ways to find out which you can open. Beware the Vengeful Ghost, an invisible monster which will attack (and generally annoy you) as you progress through the maze. You cannot kill the ghost. Your goal is all the way to the north, where you will see a Chromatic Door. Enter it to get that pesky ghost off your back, and solve the puzzle inside.
 Chromatic Door 
Now, it's time for the real puzzle. The star in the room has six triangles at its points, each a different color, and a multicolored center. Handing Chroma Spheres to the individual points changes their color, and clicking on the center gives you hints. Handing a Chroma Sphere to the triangle does not consume the Sphere, so you only need one of each to solve all the puzzles here.
The idea is to turn the points to the correct color, then click them in the correct order. There are six different solutions, and each one will grant you XP and loot from a Realaidain Chest. After each solution, loot the chest and enter the

portal to return to the Chromatic Door. The triangles will revert to their original colors after a minute or two. Upon completing all six, simply enter the puzzle room again and click the center of the star to complete Asheron's Crypt and receive your reward.

quests._desc: Bask in the knowledge of the ancient Cerulean Throne!
quests._walk:
Once completing all six Chroma Key puzzles and the Asheron's Crypt quest, you will be teleported to the deepest part of the Crypts. Head south towards the Throne Spirit Equerry.
The spirit will not attack you, but he isn't very happy to see you. Open the door to the Throne Room.
Congratulations! You have discovered the throne of the ancient Yalaini emperors, greatest of all Empyreans. You simply need to touch the throne, and there are two ways to do it. The sparkling areas in the center of the room are essentially walls, and you can maneuver around them to reach the throne. You can kill the spirit guards (65, solo) here, but they respawn quickly. The other option is not to enter the main door to the Throne room, and instead go around the sides. There are Servitors here (59, group) which can be avoided or killed. 
The side rooms offer a more direct path to the throne, but the monsters are stronger. Whichever direction you choose, touching the throne will start/complete the Cerulean Throne quest and you will obtain your reward.

quests._desc: Rumors tell of a mystical Skull Totem in the bottom of an icy cave
quests._walk:
You must venture to the bottom of the Crystal Caves, located north of Linvak Tukal. 
Proceed through the dungeon until you come to a forked path, leading left or right into two large rooms.
To the right is a large room with a ramp downward. This is the way you must you to the Singularity Trove, but you do not need to go here. Instead, go to the left, where you will see a huge chasm, some ramps, and the Skull Totem at the very bottom. 
You can either use the ramps to get to the bottom, or you can jump down. Jumping is much quicker, but you can suffer over 500 impact damage and you will need to fight several Gurogs at the bottom. Grab the Skull Totem, and return it to Mikaci to complete the quest.
 Skull Totem - A slight aura of menace surrounds this gore-encrusted skull on a stick 
 Drudge Lucky Coin - +35 luck for 15 minutes, does not stack with other Drudge luck charms

quests._desc: Unlock your own Drudge player character!
quests._walk:
You must kill Gurog on Linvak to find treasure maps. They are rare drops, but are found on most Gurog, including those at the beacon outposts. 
 Gurog Treasure Maps
Each map is used like a typical mining map, and they lead to areas in Thusik. When you find the spot, two Gurog will spawn and there is a chest with one random Siraluun Feather inside. The color of the map does not determine the color of the feather. 
 Blue Siraluun Feather
 Green Siraluun Feather
 Iridescent Siraluun Feather
You need one of each, and you must combine them to create a Siraluun Headdress.
 Siraluun Headdress
Give the Headdress to Elder Jrim for your reward.
